title: Automated carotid artery atherosclerotic inflammation segmentation in PET using MSR-Net
summary: Objective. To develop an automated method for segmentation and uptake quantification of carotid atherosclerotic inflammation on 64Cu-CANF-comb PET while accounting for partial-volume and tissue-fraction effects. Approach. Synthetic carotid PET images with known fractional-volume ground truth were generated by combining MR-derived high-resolution activity maps with GATE Monte Carlo simulation incorporating major PET physical processes and matched to the Biograph mMR acquisition and reconstruction. A two-stage network first localized the carotid vessel wall from T1-weighted MR and then estimated voxel-wise inflammation fraction from masked PET. Both stages used a multiscale residual (MSR) convolutional backbone. Performance was compared with U-Net, Transformer U-Net, DUCK-Net, and iterative Yang partial-volume correction. Main results. In a two-alternative forced-choice study, five nuclear-medicine physicians identified real images with 54% accuracy (54/100; Wilson 95% CI 0.44-0.63; exact binomial p = 0.48). On 184 simulated test slices from five held-out patients, the proposed method achieved a weighted DSC of 0.79, compared with 0.73 for U-Net, 0.69 for Transformer U-Net, and 0.75 for DUCK-Net, with corresponding HD values of 1.85, 2.29, 2.32, and 2.23 voxels. Patient-cluster bootstrap comparisons favored the proposed method for DSC and HD against all three baselines (Holm-corrected p <= 0.031). Overall ENRMSE was 0.24 versus 0.59, 0.68, and 0.59 for the three DL baselines and 0.57 for iterative Yang. In seven patients, corrected SUV showed a positive association with MR-derived lipid-rich/necrotic core with hemorrhage. Significance. The proposed framework improved carotid PET segmentation and uptake quantification under simulated conditions. The patient analysis is preliminary and requires external validation with biological reference standards before clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种两阶段多尺度残差网络，用于64Cu-CANF-comb PET颈动脉粥样硬化炎症的分割与摄取值定量，并校正部分容积和组织分数效应，在模拟数据上优于U-Net等基线方法。
AI.motivation: 颈动脉粥样硬化炎症的PET定量受部分容积效应和组织分数效应影响，导致摄取值估计偏差，需要自动化且能校正这些效应的分割与定量方法。
AI.method: 结合MR高分辨活性图与GATE蒙特卡洛模拟生成具有已知分数容积真值的合成颈动脉PET图像，匹配Biograph mMR采集与重建。采用两阶段网络：先从T1加权MR定位血管壁，再从掩膜PET估计体素级炎症分数，两阶段均用多尺度残差（MSR）卷积骨干。与U-Net、Transformer U-Net、DUCK-Net及迭代Yang部分容积校正进行比较。
AI.result: 五位核医学医生在二选一强制选择中识别真实图像准确率54%（54/100，95% CI 0.44-0.63，p=0.48）。在五名留出患者的184张模拟测试切片上，所提方法加权DSC为0.79（U-Net 0.73、Transformer U-Net 0.69、DUCK-Net 0.75），HD为1.85体素（分别为2.29、2.32、2.23）。患者聚类bootstrap显示DSC和HD优于三个基线（Holm校正p≤0.031）。总体ENRMSE为0.24，对比三个深度学习基线为0.59、0.68、0.59，迭代Yang为0.57。在七名患者中，校正后SUV与MR来源的富含脂质/坏死核心伴出血呈正相关。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在模拟条件下改善了颈动脉PET分割与摄取值定量；患者分析尚属初步，临床部署前需以生物学参考标准进行外部验证。

title: Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning
summary: We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%. It also reduces average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k. Sequent-Prover agents give answers backed by executable formal artifacts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sequent-Prover：以可执行 SMT-LIB 草稿纸进行多轮推理的验证器增强语言模型智能体，配合“验证器条件化轨迹蒸馏”后训练框架，在 37 个基准、7,254 道题上将 4B 模型单次准确率从 85.6% 提升到 97.0%，pass^4 从 64.1% 提升到 91.7%，同时减少求解器调用与 token 消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型推理缺乏可验证性：模型输出答案难以保证语义忠实，仅靠求解器成功也不代表形式化正确。作者希望让智能体给出带有可执行形式化证据的答案，并通过后训练提升其准确率、可靠性与形式化质量。
AI.method: 1) 构建 Sequent-Prover 智能体族：智能体在可执行的 SMT-LIB scratchpad 中推理，跨轮编写完整 SMT-LIB 程序、调用 Z3、检查求解器反馈、修复形式化并以显式答案终止。2) 提出验证器条件化轨迹蒸馏：从含噪教师策略出发采样多轮轨迹，保留满足“正确、非平凡、有依据、可执行”的成功轨迹尾部，再施加监督微调与轨迹级偏好优化。3) 评估维度包括任务准确率、k 样本可靠性与 SMT 程序质量。
AI.result: 在 37 个基准、每个模型族 7,254 道题上，后训练将 4B 模型的单次准确率从 85.6% 提升至 97.0%，四样本全对可靠性（pass^4）从 64.1% 提升至 91.7%。同时平均 SMT 调用次数从 4.10 降至 2.52，单次尝试 token 数从 18.97k 降至 12.72k。
AI.conclusion: Sequent-Prover 智能体能够给出由可执行形式化产物支撑的答案，兼顾准确率、可靠性与效率，为可验证的语言模型推理提供了一条可行路径。

title: Do correct answers have stable latent knowledge support?
summary: Large language models are typically evaluated in terms of the correctness of their output. However, output correctness alone does not confirm whether the latent knowledge supporting an answer has stable internal representations. We therefore propose latent state stability (LSS) and knowledge topology stability (KTS) to investigate the stability of individual knowledge states and their relational structure, respectively. Specifically, we first separately average the model's internal representations of the same knowledge under each elicitation condition. Using the mean representation under the baseline condition as a reference, we remove shared shifts to obtain corrected representations. We then formulate LSS as the distance between each corrected representation and its reference representation, normalized against the typical distance between knowledge items of the same type. We formulate KTS as the cross-condition consistency of the ordered pairwise representation distances among knowledge items of the same type. Next, we construct EpiStableBench, which comprises 4,411 items spanning factual knowledge and mathematical reasoning, with 76,766 controlled queries. Across 16 LLMs from four families, representation stability varies substantially even among items answered correctly under the base condition. Within models, higher stability generally corresponds to higher accuracy under held-out elicitation conditions; across models, stability does not consistently increase with model size or overall accuracy. Meanwhile, we present LatentDPO to learn a knowledge-editing policy that accounts for the stability of latent knowledge. Experimental results show that integrating LatentDPO with multiple existing editing methods consistently improves editing success and generalization across different expressions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出潜状态稳定性(LSS)与知识拓扑稳定性(KTS)两项指标，并构建EpiStableBench基准，评估16个LLM内部知识表征的稳定性，发现稳定性与泛化准确率相关，并提出LatentDPO提升知识编辑效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估主要关注输出正确性，但输出正确并不意味着支撑答案的潜在知识具有稳定的内部表征，因此需要从表征稳定性角度刻画模型内部知识状态及其关系结构。
AI.method: 先在每种引出条件下对同一知识的内部表征取均值，以基线条件下的均值表征为参考，去除共享漂移得到校正表征。LSS定义为校正表征与参考表征的距离，并按同类型知识项间的典型距离归一化；KTS定义为同类型知识项之间有序成对表征距离的跨条件一致性。据此构建EpiStableBench（4,411个知识项、76,766条受控查询，覆盖事实知识与数学推理），并设计LatentDPO学习考虑潜在知识稳定性的知识编辑策略。
AI.result: 在四大家族共16个LLM上，即使基线条件下答对的知识项，其表征稳定性也差异显著；模型内部稳定性越高，留出引出条件下的准确率通常越高；跨模型看，稳定性不随模型规模或整体准确率单调提升。LatentDPO与多种现有编辑方法结合，可一致提升编辑成功率及不同表述下的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 输出正确性不足以反映内部知识表征的稳定性，LSS与KTS提供了可量化的稳定性评估视角，EpiStableBench支持系统性评测，而LatentDPO表明将稳定性纳入知识编辑具有实际收益。

title: GeoBridge: Evolving Transferable Decoder Topologies for Geometric Vision
summary: Depth estimation and Gaussian reconstruction share a need for multi-scale feature processing, yet use different prediction interfaces and training objectives. Whether a decoder's internal computation can be optimized once and reused across these systems remains a structural design question. Search over primitive configurations alone leaves the organization of transformations fixed. To address this gap, we propose GeoBridge, an evolutionary framework for transferable decoder topologies. First, GeoBridge makes stage-internal topology searchable through residual, sequential, and parallel composition of configurable primitives. Shape-preserving composition retains the stage interfaces of a fixed multi-scale scaffold. Second, a functional-tree encoding supports stage-aware crossover and hierarchical mutation, while a gradient sensitivity-alignment proxy evaluates candidates without training. Multi-objective evolution balances this proxy with computation and parameter cost. Third, selected topologies are instantiated and trained in target systems with task-specific prediction interfaces. A single source search takes approximately 12 GPU hours. GeoBridgeNet-A3 achieves the best depth accuracy among four adapted decoder baselines under a common encoder and training protocol on NYU Depth V2 and KITTI. The same topology reaches 27.11 dB PSNR in Gaussian novel-view synthesis on RealEstate10K, and its refined representations support open-vocabulary segmentation on LERF. These results support decoder topology as a reusable design object across the evaluated geometric vision systems. Code and pretrained weights are available at https://github.com/EMI-Group/GeoBridge-NAS.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoBridge，一种可迁移解码器拓扑的进化搜索框架，通过阶段内拓扑搜索与功能树编码，实现单次搜索、跨深度估计与高斯重建复用。
AI.motivation: 深度估计与高斯重建都需多尺度特征处理，但预测接口与训练目标不同。仅搜索基础模块配置无法改变变换的组织方式，解码器内部计算能否"一次优化、跨系统复用"仍是未解决的结构设计问题。
AI.method: 1) 通过残差、串行、并行组合可配置原语，使阶段内拓扑可搜索，保形组合保持固定多尺度骨架的阶段接口；2) 功能树编码支持阶段感知交叉与层次变异，并用梯度敏感度对齐代理免训练评估候选，多目标进化权衡代理、计算量与参数成本；3) 选定拓扑在目标系统中以任务特定预测接口实例化并训练。
AI.result: 单次源搜索约12 GPU小时。GeoBridgeNet-A3在NYU Depth V2与KITTI上，于相同编码器和训练协议下取得四个适配解码器基线中最佳深度精度；同一拓扑在RealEstate10K高斯新视角合成达27.11 dB PSNR，其精炼表征还支持LERF上的开放词汇分割。
AI.conclusion: 解码器拓扑可作为可复用设计对象，在所评估的几何视觉系统中跨任务迁移有效。代码与预训练权重已开源。

title: North or South? Diagnosing LLMs' Understanding of North Korean Language, Society, and Knowledge
comment: Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 19 pages, 1 figure, 11 tables
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Evaluating diverse recent LLMs, we find a modest performance drop on North Korean language inputs, a larger gap in sociocultural perspective alignment, and severe limitations on domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project liberal-democratic assumptions, or rely on coarse stereotypes. Our results demonstrate that linguistic similarity alone does not guarantee sociocultural or domain-specific understanding, highlighting the critical need for grounded evaluation resources for underrepresented cultural and political contexts.

AI.tldr: 提出 LENS 基准（1,765 题），从语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域知识三维度评估 LLM 对朝鲜社会语境的理解，发现语言性能仅有小幅下降，但社会文化对齐差距更大、领域知识严重不足。
AI.motivation: LLM 在多语言问答上进展显著，但对低资源社会语言学语境的理解仍缺乏研究；朝鲜半岛长期分隔造成词汇、正字法、规范与意识形态话语上的差异，构成独特测试场，而现有评估资源未覆盖此类被低估的文化与政治语境。
AI.method: 构建经人工验证的 LENS 基准，含 1,765 个问题，覆盖三个评估维度：语言鲁棒性、社会文化视角对齐、领域特定知识；据此评测多个近期 LLM，并进行定性分析。
AI.result: 朝鲜语输入上性能仅小幅下降；社会文化视角对齐差距更大；领域特定知识受限严重。定性分析显示模型常将正式制度与生活现实混淆、投射自由民主假设、依赖粗粒度刻板印象。
AI.conclusion: 语言相似性本身并不保证社会文化或领域特定理解，凸显为代表性不足的文化与政治语境构建有据可依的评估资源的迫切需求。

title: Protein Crystallization Segmentation and Classification Using Subordinate Color Channel in Fluorescence Microscopy Images
summary: The accuracy of detecting protein crystals for fluorescence microscopy images is very critical for high throughput and automated systems. Although the trace fluorescent labeling method could highlight protein crystals, reflection and emission from the fluorescence dye is not always due to crystal regions. Therefore, the analysis of the peak wavelength in the emission spectra of a fluorophore may not always yield effective results. In this paper, we show that using the subordinate color intensity corresponding to longer wavelengths than the peak wavelength of the emission spectra could improve the accuracy of protein crystal detection. Hence, we have built a segmentation method based on the percentile intensity of the subordinate color for trace fluorescently labeled (TFL'd) protein crystallization trial images. Compared to using the dominant color channel, our segmentation method on subordinate color channel was able to reduce the misclassification rate of likely-leads or crystals as non-crystals by the percentage of from 9.71% to 2.02% depending on the classifier. Similarly, the accuracy of classifiers were increased by the percentage of from 1.77% to 5.53%. Our method reached around 94% accuracy while keeping misclassification of likely-leads and crystals as non-crystals below 1%. Moreover, to evaluate the generalizability of our method, we have conducted new wet lab experiments on two proteins, Concanavalin A (Con A) and Ab inorganic pyrophosphate (AbIPPase), and the misclassification rate was below 1%. Our experiments show that using the subordinate channel may be more helpful for TFL'd protein trial image classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于TFL荧光图像中发射光谱主峰长波侧“从属颜色通道”的百分位强度分割方法，用于提高蛋白质晶体检测准确率，并在两个新蛋白湿实验中验证了泛化性。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微图像中蛋白质晶体的自动检测对高通量和自动化系统至关重要。尽管痕量荧光标记（TFL）能突出晶体区域，但荧光染料的反射与发射并非总来自晶体区域，因此仅依据发射光谱峰值波长进行分析往往效果不佳，需要更可靠的颜色特征来提升检测精度。
AI.method: 利用发射光谱峰值波长对应更长波长的“从属颜色”强度（subordinate color intensity），构建基于从属颜色通道百分位强度的分割方法，对TFL蛋白质结晶试验图像进行分割；并与使用主导颜色通道的基线方法对比，评估多种分类器性能。此外，开展针对Concanavalin A（Con A）和Ab inorganic pyrophosphate（AbIPPase）两种蛋白质的新湿实验以检验泛化性。
AI.result: 相比主导颜色通道，从属颜色通道分割将“候选lead或晶体被误判为非晶体”的误分类率从9.71%降至2.02%（依分类器而异）；分类器准确率提升1.77%至5.53%。方法总体准确率约达94%，且将likely-leads与晶体的误判率保持在1%以下；在两个新蛋白湿实验中误分类率同样低于1%。
AI.conclusion: 使用从属颜色通道比主导通道更有利于TFL蛋白质试验图像的分类，可显著降低关键漏检并提升准确率，且方法具有较好的泛化性。

title: ASM-6D: Fast Certified Pose-Shape Inference with Complete Correspondence Flow Maps
summary: Category-level 6D pose and shape estimation requires recovering an object's pose and geometry from partial observations without an exact instance model. We present ASM-6D, which couples generative complete-geometry prediction with explicit category-level pose-shape inference through shared correspondences. Given an RGB-D image, ASM-6D generates alternative complete 3D correspondence hypotheses whose point identities are shared with a category-level Active Shape Model (ASM), including occluded points. Each hypothesis is fitted directly for rotation, translation, metric scale, and instance shape without a separate correspondence-assignment stage. We analytically eliminate translation and shape coefficients, reducing fitting to a nine-variable scaled-rotation optimization problem that enables efficient batched evaluation of multiple hypotheses in real time. ASM-6D achieves state-of-the-art performance on ROPE and HouseCat6D benchmarks. Ablations demonstrate the importance of generative correspondence prediction and active shape variation. The representation also supports shape completion, shape-dependent pose ambiguity, tracking, and robotic grasping at 6-38 Hz, depending on the inference budget.

AI.tldr: 提出 ASM-6D，通过将生成式完整几何预测与显式的类别级位姿-形状推断耦合到共享对应关系上，实现类别级 6D 位姿与形状估计，并在 ROPE 与 HouseCat6D 上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 类别级 6D 位姿与形状估计需在无精确实例模型条件下，从部分观测中恢复物体的位姿与几何，现有方法通常依赖独立的对应匹配阶段，效率与鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 给定 RGB-D 图像，ASM-6D 生成多个候选完整 3D 对应假设，其点身份与类别级主动形状模型（ASM）共享，涵盖被遮挡点；每个假设直接拟合旋转、平移、度量尺度与实例形状，无需单独的对应分配阶段；通过解析消去平移与形状系数，将拟合问题简化为九变量的缩放旋转优化，支持多假设的实时批量评估。
AI.result: 在 ROPE 与 HouseCat6D 基准上达到 SOTA 性能；消融实验验证生成式对应预测与主动形状变化的重要性；该表示还支持形状补全、形状相关的位姿歧义、跟踪与机器人抓取，运行速度为 6–38 Hz（取决于推理预算）。
AI.conclusion: ASM-6D 通过共享对应关系将生成式完整几何预测与类别级位姿-形状推断统一，简化优化并提升效率，具备多任务扩展能力。

title: Co-DSL: Human-LLM Co-design of Reusable Spatial Concepts for Layout Generation
summary: We present Co-DSL, a framework in which users and LLMs co-design reusable spatial concepts for layout generation. In the first stage, our system allows users to create a library of personalized operations. To add a concept, a user provides a description, which the LLM converts into an initial implementation. The user can then observe the concept's execution behavior over example scenarios and provide lightweight feedback to the LLM, which revises the concept's implementation logic. In the second stage, given a library, an LLM can author a layout program that meets a new layout request from a user. Executing a layout program instantiates a concept-graph, a declarative composition of library concepts. In this way, we require the LLM only to specify which concepts should hold, while we use a solver to search for a layout that satisfies them. Across five spatial layout domains, we find that Co-DSL libraries let LLMs capture layout patterns that are challenging for prior fixed-operation systems, and demonstrate that our concept-graph representation is needed for LLMs to reliably compose concepts together. We further find that Co-DSL lets LLMs author generative layout programs that expose high-level parametric controls users can manipulate to explore a distribution of related layouts without re-prompting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Co-DSL 框架，通过用户与大语言模型协同设计可复用的空间概念库，实现布局生成；LLM 负责编写布局程序，求解器负责搜索满足概念的布局，并在五个空间布局领域验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有布局生成系统依赖固定操作集，难以表达多样化的个性化布局模式，LLM 也难以可靠地组合操作。作者希望让用户与 LLM 共同设计可复用的空间概念，以克服固定操作系统的局限。
AI.method: Co-DSL 分两阶段：第一阶段构建个性化操作库，用户给出描述，LLM 生成初始实现，用户观察概念在示例场景中的执行行为并给出轻量反馈，LLM 据此修正实现逻辑；第二阶段 LLM 根据新布局请求编写布局程序，执行时实例化概念图（concept-graph），即库中概念的声明式组合。LLM 只负责指定应满足哪些概念，由求解器搜索满足这些概念的布局。
AI.result: 在五个空间布局领域中，Co-DSL 库使 LLM 能够捕捉以往固定操作系统难以处理的布局模式；概念图表示对于 LLM 可靠地组合概念是必要的；Co-DSL 还使 LLM 能够编写生成式布局程序，暴露高层参数化控制，用户无需重新提示即可探索相关布局分布。
AI.conclusion: 用户与 LLM 协同设计可复用空间概念并结合求解器的框架，能够提升 LLM 对复杂布局模式的捕捉与概念组合的可靠性，并支持可参数化的生成式布局探索。

title: HGA-Quant: Heterogeneity-Aware Quantization for AutoRegressive Visual Generation Models
summary: Recently, AutoRegressive Visual Generation (ARVG) models have emerged as a competitive paradigm for high-quality image synthesis. However, their substantial computational and memory demands make them difficult to deploy on resource-constrained edge devices. Post-Training Quantization (PTQ) provides a promising solution to reduce the computational and memory costs of ARVG models, yet existing methods often suffer from substantial image quality degradation under low-bit quantization. In this paper, we propose a training-free PTQ framework for ARVG, consisting of Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement (T-BGR) and Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling (CAPS). T-BGR introduces a tail-aware reconstruction objective for weight quantizer calibration, assigning greater importance to distribution-tail coefficients and preserving fine-grained information without introducing additional parameters or high-precision branches. CAPS performs coarse-to-fine activation precision scheduling by jointly considering the importance and computational cost of different generation stages, enabling efficient mixed-precision allocation under a given bit budget. Extensive experiments on multiple ARVG backbones demonstrate that our framework consistently improves robustness under aggressive low-bit quantization. Notably, on Infinity, our framework achieves near full-precision image generation quality at an effective W4A5.6 activation precision, while existing methods at W4A6 still exhibit noticeable quality degradation or inconsistent performance. Code is available at https://github.com/lxm-lc/HGA-Quant.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种免训练的后训练量化（PTQ）框架，用于自回归视觉生成（ARVG）模型，通过 T-BGR 与 CAPS 两个组件在低比特下保持图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: ARVG 模型虽能生成高质量图像，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘设备上；现有 PTQ 方法在低比特量化下会导致明显的图像质量下降。
AI.method: 提出免训练 PTQ 框架，包含：(1) Tail-Aware Bounded-init Grid Refinement (T-BGR)，为权重量化器校准引入尾部感知重建目标，对分布尾部系数赋予更高重要性，在不增加额外参数或高精度分支的前提下保留细粒度信息；(2) Coarse-to-Fine Activation Precision Scheduling (CAPS)，联合考虑不同生成阶段的重要性和计算成本，进行由粗到细的激活精度调度，在给定比特预算下实现高效混合精度分配。
AI.result: 在多个 ARVG 骨干网络上，该框架在激进低比特量化下持续提升鲁棒性；在 Infinity 上，以有效 W4A5.6 激活精度实现接近全精度的图像生成质量，而现有方法在 W4A6 下仍存在明显质量下降或性能不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的免训练 PTQ 框架能有效缓解 ARVG 模型低比特量化下的质量退化，在有限比特预算下实现高质量的图像生成，具有良好的部署价值。

title: Channel Match: Calibrating Shape Latents for Few-Step 3D Generation
summary: Recent native 3D generators achieve high-quality asset creation by modeling structured 3D latents with flow-based transformers, but their high-resolution generation remains computationally expensive due to costly iterative sampling. In this work, we introduce a few-step distillation framework for native 3D generation, enabled by continuous self-consistency training with a custom JVP FlashAttention kernel and an analytic velocity regression objective for sparse structured 3D latents. To stabilize joint optimization, we further introduce an adaptive loss weighting strategy that automatically balances them without manual tuning. Beyond acceleration, we reveal a previously overlooked failure mode of few-step native 3D generation: sampling-induced latent distribution drift preserves geometric correctness but disrupts downstream PBR texture synthesis, causing texture artifacts on geometrically valid assets. To address this issue, we propose Channel Match, a training-free adaptive per-channel latent calibration method that restores the latent distribution without modifying either generator. We validate our approach on TRELLIS.2 at the $1024^3$ resolution setting. Our two-step model achieves $4.5\times$ faster geometry sampling while maintaining geometry quality comparable to the many-step teacher, and Channel Match further improves rendering quality by recovering the latent interface between geometry and appearance generation.

AI.tldr: 面向原生3D生成提出少步蒸馏框架（连续自一致性训练+自定义JVP FlashAttention核+解析速度回归+自适应损失加权），并揭示采样诱导的潜分布漂移导致PBR纹理伪影，提出免训练逐通道校准Channel Match；在TRELLIS.2 1024^3上实现2步4.5×几何采样加速且质量可比。
AI.motivation: 原生3D生成器借助流匹配Transformer建模结构化3D潜表示，可生成高质量资产，但高分辨率下迭代采样代价高昂。此外，少步原生3D生成存在被忽视的失效模式：采样导致的潜分布漂移虽保持几何正确，却破坏下游PBR纹理合成，在几何有效的资产上产生纹理伪影。
AI.method: 1) 少步蒸馏框架：采用连续自一致性训练，配合自定义JVP FlashAttention核，并针对稀疏结构化3D潜表示设计解析速度回归目标；2) 引入自适应损失加权策略，自动平衡各项损失，无需人工调参；3) 提出Channel Match：免训练、自适应、逐通道的潜校准方法，在不修改任何生成器的情况下恢复潜分布，从而修复几何生成与外观生成之间的潜接口。
AI.result: 在TRELLIS.2的1024^3分辨率设置下验证：两步模型几何采样速度提升4.5×，几何质量与多步教师模型相当；Channel Match进一步改善渲染质量，通过恢复几何与外观生成之间的潜接口缓解纹理伪影。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过连续自一致性蒸馏与解析速度回归实现原生3D高分辨率少步生成加速，并提出训练无关的Channel Match校准，解决少步采样潜分布漂移引发的纹理退化问题，为高效且高质量的原生3D资产生成提供了可行路径。

title: TempoKV: Predictive KV Cache Quantization for Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models enable streaming generation of long videos but suffer from significant memory overhead due to the rapidly growing KV cache. Existing KV cache quantization methods are primarily designed for LLMs and transfer poorly to video models, where activations exhibit different statistics and strong spatiotemporal redundancy. We observe that the video KV cache is largely predictable over time, with a clear asymmetry. Keys are highly predictable from their temporal history, while values depend primarily on the current key and need a short history of preceding values. Based on these observations, we propose \textbf{\method}, a training-free predictive KV cache quantization framework for AR video generation. \method predicts keys and values according to their distinct dependencies and stores only the residuals at low precision. Both predictors are lightweight, calibrated once offline by linear regression on a small set of BF16 samples, and remain fixed across prompts and generation runs. Experiments on Self-Forcing, Causal Forcing, and LongCat-Video-13B show that \method consistently achieves higher generation quality than existing KV cache quantization methods at comparable or higher compression ratios, reaching up to $6.71\times$ KV cache compression with the best overall quality--efficiency tradeoff. Our code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练预测式KV缓存量化框架，利用视频KV缓存的可预测性与键值不对称性，仅低精度存储残差，实现最高6.71倍压缩并保持更优生成质量。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型可实现长视频流式生成，但KV缓存快速增长带来显著显存开销。现有KV缓存量化方法主要面向LLM，迁移到视频模型效果差，因为视频模型激活统计不同且存在强时空冗余。
AI.method: 观察到视频KV缓存随时间高度可预测且存在明显不对称性：键可由其时间历史高度预测，值主要依赖当前键并需少量前序值历史。据此提出免训练的预测式KV缓存量化框架，按各自依赖分别预测键和值，仅以低精度存储残差；两个预测器均为轻量级，通过少量BF16样本上的线性回归一次性离线校准，并在不同提示与生成过程中保持固定。
AI.result: 在Self-Forcing、Causal Forcing和LongCat-Video-13B上，该方法在相当或更高压缩比下持续取得优于现有KV缓存量化方法的生成质量，KV缓存压缩最高达6.71倍，并具有最佳的整体质量-效率权衡。
AI.conclusion: 利用视频KV缓存的时序可预测性与键值依赖不对称性进行预测式残差量化，可在免训练、低开销条件下显著压缩KV缓存并保持生成质量，代码将在GitHub发布。

title: CIViC: Evidence Gates for Audio-Conditioned Visual Prediction on Proxy Tasks
summary: Removing audio can shift a visual predictor's output without showing whether the task uses the intended audio information. We introduce Conditional Input and Visual Interpretation Checks (CIViC), a four-gate protocol that links an interpretation to an intervention, held-out task comparison, or endpoint control. We demonstrate CIViC on actor-disjoint face-raster tests, a synthetic audio-feature mixture, and source-video-disjoint SpeakerVid proxy tasks. In the static face-raster test, cross-actor audio replacement meets the registered detection rule with a small effect; on a separate temporal endpoint, constant-audio fits score better than audio-trained fits in four matched seeds. In the synthetic mixture, the condition-augmented fit has higher 1,000-step RMSE than the audio-only fit (0.1807 vs. 0.1707), with the gap shrinking during training. In the SpeakerVid proxy, the five-feature-zero fit (five low-level audio summaries zeroed; identity, dialogue, and condition inputs retained) has lower whole-frame grayscale RMSE than aligned audio across four held-out conditions and five paired seeds, while aligned audio has lower segment-drift error. The results show that output activation, held-out error, and endpoint controls support different interpretations across these proxy tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CIViC四门协议，通过将解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制相绑定，检验视听预测器是否真正使用了预期的音频信息，并在三类代理任务中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 仅移除音频虽会改变视觉预测器的输出，却无法证明该任务确实使用了预期的音频信息，因此需要一种更严格的检验协议来区分"输出被激活"与"信息被真正使用"这两种不同解释。
AI.method: 提出CIViC四门协议，将解释与干预、留出任务比较或端点控制相链接；在演员不交叉的人脸光栅测试、合成音频特征混合任务、以及源视频不交叉的SpeakerVid代理任务上进行验证。
AI.result: 静态人脸光栅测试中，跨演员音频替换以较小效应满足预设检测规则，但在另一时间端点，恒定音频拟合在四个匹配随机种子下优于音频训练拟合；合成混合中，条件增强拟合的1000步RMSE高于纯音频拟合（0.1807 vs. 0.1707），差距随训练缩小；SpeakerVid代理中，五特征置零拟合在四个留出条件和五个配对种子下全帧灰度RMSE低于对齐音频，而对齐音频的片段漂移误差更低。
AI.conclusion: 输出激活、留出误差与端点控制在这些代理任务中支持不同的解释，表明单一指标不足以判定模型是否真正使用了预期音频信息，需结合多门检验综合判断。

title: BaT-SAM: Introducing Inductive Bias into SAM via a Mixture of Convolutional Experts for Brain Tumor Segmentation
summary: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis and treatment planning; however, manual delineation is labor-intensive and time-consuming. Existing approaches are either task-specific with limited generalization or rely on user-provided prompts during inference. We present BaT-SAM, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework that enables fully automatic brain tumor segmentation with the Segment Anything Model (SAM). BaT-SAM injects local inductive bias into SAM's frozen Vision Transformer (ViT) encoder via Conv-LoRA, where image features are processed by a sparsely gated mixture of multi-scale convolutional experts. This design compensates for the limited translation-equivariant inductive bias of vanilla ViTs while fine-tuning fewer than 5M parameters (less than 1% of the full model). To remove the need for user prompts, we further introduce a lightweight self-prompting box regressor that is jointly optimized with the adapter using scheduled sampling and predicts tumor locations directly from image embeddings. On the BRISC2025 benchmark, BaT-SAM achieves a weighted mean IoU of 0.832 while outperforming state-of-the-art benchmarks. It further demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization, achieving Dice scores of 0.702 on Figshare and 0.784 on the LGG MRI Segmentation dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出BaT-SAM，一种参数高效的自适应框架，通过Conv-LoRA和自提示框回归器实现全自动脑肿瘤分割，在BRISC2025上达到0.832加权平均IoU并具备良好跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: MRI脑肿瘤分割对诊断和治疗规划至关重要，但人工勾画耗时耗力。现有方法要么任务专用、泛化性有限，要么依赖推理时的用户提示，因此需要一种全自动且泛化性强的分割方案。
AI.method: 基于SAM构建BaT-SAM框架：通过Conv-LoRA向SAM冻结的ViT编码器注入局部归纳偏置，图像特征由稀疏门控的多尺度卷积专家混合处理，以弥补ViT平移等变归纳偏置的不足，仅微调不到5M参数（不足全模型1%）；同时引入轻量级自提示框回归器，采用计划采样与适配器联合优化，直接从图像嵌入预测肿瘤位置，免除用户提示。
AI.result: 在BRISC2025基准上取得0.832的加权平均IoU，优于现有最先进方法；跨数据集泛化表现强劲，在Figshare上Dice为0.702，在LGG MRI Segmentation数据集上Dice为0.784。
AI.conclusion: BaT-SAM以极低的可训练参数量实现了全自动、高精度且跨数据集泛化良好的脑肿瘤分割，验证了Conv-LoRA与自提示机制结合SAM的有效性。

title: StimFlow: Synthesizing Brain Activity from Images via Stimulus-conditioned Flow Matching
summary: The inherent variability of fMRI responses across trials encourages a generative view of the stimulus-to-response mapping. Prior generative encoders often operate in compressed latent spaces and condition predominantly on semantic features, which provide limited low-level cues for early visual cortex. We propose StimFlow, which synthesizes fMRI directly in native voxel space using conditional flow matching with a linear path. This design aligns training and inference distributions, enabling competitive performance with a single sample and reducing reliance on averaging. To match the visual hierarchy, StimFlow combines structural DINOv2 features with semantic CLIP features, which prove complementary along the cortical processing stream. With a single sample, StimFlow achieves a per-voxel Pearson correlation of 0.371, matching baselines that average five draws. Generation in voxel space allows direct ROI analysis and concept localization without a decoder. Furthermore, it recovers over half of full-data performance from just one hour of scans, supporting efficient cross-subject adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出StimFlow，用条件流匹配在原生体素空间直接合成fMRI响应，单样本即达0.371体素级Pearson相关，媲美五次平均的基线，并支持ROI分析与跨被试快速适配。
AI.motivation: fMRI响应在试次间存在内在变异性，适合用生成式视角建模刺激到响应的映射。但既有生成式编码器多在压缩潜空间操作，且主要依赖语义特征作为条件，难以为早期视觉皮层提供低层线索。
AI.method: StimFlow采用线性路径的条件流匹配，直接在原生体素空间合成fMRI，使训练与推理分布对齐；同时融合DINOv2的结构特征与CLIP的语义特征作为条件，以匹配视觉皮层的层级处理特性。
AI.result: 单样本下StimFlow取得0.371的体素级Pearson相关，与平均五次采样的基线相当；因在体素空间生成，无需解码器即可进行ROI分析与概念定位；仅用一小时扫描数据即可恢复到全数据性能的一半以上。
AI.conclusion: 在原生体素空间进行条件流匹配生成，配合结构—语义互补特征，可有效建模fMRI响应变异性，提升单样本性能并支持高效跨被试适配与直接可解释分析。

title: Across Viewpoints and Time: Trajectory-Generalizable Physical Attacks on World Models and Video Understanding Models
summary: World models and video understanding models are increasingly deployed in dynamic visual environments, yet their robustness to physical adversarial threats remains largely underexplored. We study whether a single physical adversarial texture can mislead the victim model across different real-world scenarios where observing viewpoints vary along uncontrolled object--camera trajectories. We identify that heterogeneous video semantics and trajectories induce poorly aligned gradients for optimizing the adversarial texture. To address that, we propose the Trajectory-aware adversarial Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA), which incorporates trajectory-aware optimization to capture the evolving geometric variations of a printed texture under real-world scenarios. To improve cross-instance optimization compatibility, TARA incorporates trajectory-aware contrastive alignment to encourage attacked representations from diverse video--trajectory instances to approach a shared adversarial region and then performs trajectory-aware task refinement to translate the aligned representation into task-level prediction errors. For reproducible evaluation, we develop a geometry-grounded tracking pipeline that provides physically plausible adversarial regions with temporally consistent trajectories on EPIC-KITCHENS-100 and Something-Something V2. We further collect real-world print-and-recapture videos to validate attack effectiveness under physical deployment conditions. Together, the annotated benchmarks and real-world captured data form a reproducible testbed for future evaluation. Notably, our results reveal that a single printable adversarial texture can persistently disrupt world models and video understanding models under physical conditions, highlighting the fundamental security challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文研究物理对抗贴纸对世界模型与视频理解模型的威胁，提出轨迹感知的对抗优化方法TARA，并用几何跟踪管线在真实场景中验证单个可打印纹理可稳定误导模型。
AI.motivation: 世界模型与视频理解模型日益部署于动态视觉环境，但其对物理对抗威胁的鲁棒性鲜有研究。核心问题是：单一物理对抗纹理能否在视角沿不可控物体-相机轨迹变化的多种真实场景中持续误导模型。
AI.method: 提出Trajectory-aware Alignment and Refinement Attack (TARA)：1) 轨迹感知优化，建模打印纹理在真实场景中随几何变化的演化；2) 轨迹感知对比对齐，使不同视频-轨迹实例的被攻击表征收敛到共享对抗区域，提升跨实例优化兼容性；3) 轨迹感知任务精化，将对齐后的表征转化为任务级预测错误。此外构建几何约束的跟踪流水线，在EPIC-KITCHENS-100与Something-Something V2上生成物理合理的对抗区域与时间一致轨迹，并采集真实打印-重录视频。
AI.result: 单个可打印对抗纹理在物理条件下能持续干扰世界模型与视频理解模型，攻击在物理部署情境下依然有效；同时形成了包含标注基准与真实采集数据的可复现测试平台。
AI.conclusion: 异构视频语义与轨迹导致梯度对齐不佳是物理对抗优化的关键难点，TARA通过轨迹感知的对齐与精化有效解决该问题。研究揭示了物理对抗纹理对世界模型与视频理解模型的根本性安全挑战，并提供可复现评测基准。

title: Video-Based Sexual Harassment Detection Using Fine-Tuned Video Transformers
summary: Sexual harassment represents a pervasive societal challenge, with a substantial proportion of incidents remaining unreported due to insufficient evidence and delayed intervention mechanisms. Smart surveillance systems capable of detecting such incidents in real-time could assist law enforcement and serve as a deterrent. However, video-based harassment detection poses significant challenges, including variations in clothing, illumina- tion, partial occlusions, low resolution, and diverse camera view- points. Despite its social importance, this problem has received limited research attention, primarily due to the scarcity of large- scale annotated video datasets. To address this gap, we extend the Sexual Harassment Video (SHV) dataset to 600 short video clips sourced from YouTube and annotated into harassment and non-harassment categories using consistent labeling guidelines. We fine-tune three state-of-the-art video transformer models, VideoMAE, ViViT, and TimeSformer, pretrained on Kinetics- 400, for binary harassment classification. Experimental results show that all three models achieve competitive classification performance, with TimeSformer attaining the highest test accu- racy of 92.27%, outperforming VideoMAE 91.71% and ViViT 91.16% on the extended SHV test set. Our analysis reveals that performance is notably influenced by dataset size, video quality, frame sampling strategy, and model architecture. This work presents a comprehensive evaluation of modern video transformers for this sensitive real-world task.

AI.tldr: 该研究将性骚扰视频数据集SHV扩展至600段短视频，并用VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer三种视频Transformer做二分类检测，TimeSformer取得最高92.27%准确率。
AI.motivation: 性骚扰是普遍的社会挑战，多数事件因证据不足和干预滞后而未被举报；实时智能监控可辅助执法并起到威慑作用。但视频性骚扰检测面临服装、光照、遮挡、低分辨率、视角多样等困难，且因缺乏大规模标注视频数据集，相关研究十分有限。
AI.method: 扩展Sexual Harassment Video（SHV）数据集至600段来自YouTube的短视频，按统一标注准则划分为骚扰与非骚扰两类；基于Kinetics-400预训练的VideoMAE、ViViT、TimeSformer三种先进视频Transformer模型进行微调，完成二分类任务。
AI.result: 三种模型均取得有竞争力的分类性能，在扩展SHV测试集上TimeSformer以92.27%的测试准确率最高，优于VideoMAE的91.71%和ViViT的91.16%；分析表明性能受数据集规模、视频质量、帧采样策略和模型架构显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 该工作对现代视频Transformer在性骚扰检测这一敏感现实任务上进行了全面评估，为后续研究提供了扩展数据集与基准参考。

title: UniForge3D: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Generation in a Shared Anchor-Guided Space
summary: Generating complete 3D assets from sparse, unposed images requires preserving observed geometry while completing unseen regions. Joint reconstruction and generation offers a way to address both goals: reconstruction recovers the geometry observed in the input images, while generation contributes learned shape priors. However, combining camera-relative reconstruction with canonical-space generation introduces a coordinate mismatch that makes direct geometric interaction more difficult. Moreover, conditioning each 3D location on all views without accounting for their relevance may mix useful geometric evidence with unrelated image content, hindering local detail recovery. We present UniForge3D, which jointly models reconstruction and generation in a shared anchor-guided space, resolving their coordinate mismatch. This space follows the anchor view's azimuth while keeping the object upright. The two branches exchange features bidirectionally to predict per-view point maps and a complete sparse voxel structure. We further condition point-map prediction on the generated structure to establish pixel-to-voxel correspondences and select the most informative input view for each voxel. Features from the selected views then guide detailed shape generation, helping preserve observed geometric details. Our method achieves state-of-the-art appearance and geometry results on Toys4K and GSO, generating complete 3D assets with improved fidelity. Project webpage: https://xishuxishu.github.io/uniforge3d-project/

AI.tldr: 提出 UniForge3D，在共享 anchor 引导空间中联合建模重建与生成，解决坐标不匹配与多视图条件混合问题，实现稀疏无位姿图像的高保真完整三维资产生成。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏且无位姿的图像生成完整三维资产，需在保留已观测几何的同时补全未见区域。联合重建与生成可兼顾两点：重建恢复输入观测几何，生成提供学习到的形状先验。但相机坐标系下的重建与规范空间生成存在坐标不匹配，难以直接进行几何交互；同时若对每个三维位置无差别地条件化所有视图，会混淆有用几何证据与无关图像内容，损害局部细节恢复。
AI.method: 提出 UniForge3D，在共享的 anchor 引导空间中联合建模重建与生成以消除坐标不匹配：该空间沿用 anchor 视图的方位角并保持物体直立。两个分支双向交换特征，预测逐视图点图与完整稀疏体素结构。进一步以生成的体素结构条件化点图预测，建立像素到体素的对应关系，并为每个体素选择信息量最大的输入视图，用所选视图特征引导细节形状生成。
AI.result: 在 Toys4K 与 GSO 数据集上取得最先进的外观与几何结果，生成的完整三维资产保真度更高。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享 anchor 引导空间统一重建与生成、以结构引导的点图预测与逐体素视图选择，有效缓解了坐标不一致与多视图条件噪声问题，显著提升稀疏无位姿输入下完整三维资产的重建与生成质量。

title: A Sovereign, Indic-First, Reasoning Model
summary: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B is a long-context hybrid Mamba-Transformer mixture-of-experts model for reasoning, instruction following, and tool use in English and eight Indian languages. Starting from NVIDIA's Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B checkpoint, it retains the 52-layer backbone and changes the vocabulary, training data, and post-training objectives. An in-place expansion from 131,072 to 163,072 tokens reduces mean Indian-language fertility by 38.6%. The new embedding rows are initialized from their upstream decompositions and warmed before the backbone is updated. Continual pretraining then adds broad English-Indic data, high-quality annealing, and direct training at a 131,072-token sequence length. The central result appears after post-training. Reinforcement learning across four verifiable task environments improves mathematics, graduate-level science, and instruction following, but degrades Indic extractive question answering because the rewards do not require an answer in the requested language. The share of Indic extraction items answered in English rises from 8.7% to 91.7%. Accuracy conditional on answering in the target script roughly doubles, which is consistent with preserved reading ability but is measured on a self-selected subset. Two unreleased studies test repairs. A scoped Indic reward restores the language convention. A 26B-A4B generative judge outperforms a 235B-parameter model on RM-Bench, and distillation restores 81% of the capabilities displaced by optimizing against it. Relative to the architecture-identical starting checkpoint, the released model gains 5.2 points on an Indic aggregate while giving up 1.7 points of English retention. The unreleased Indic-aware branch trades further, gaining 14.6 Indic points at a cost of 5.4 in English. A planned FP8 release reduces the artifact to 32GB with near-zero mean change across 32 paired benchmarks.

AI.tldr: Gnani-Evon-v3.3-30B-A3B 是基于 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 构建的长上下文 Mamba-Transformer MoE 模型，支持英语及八种印度语言；通过词表就地扩展、持续预训练与后训练提升印度语言能力，但 RL 阶段因奖励未约束语言导致用英语作答的抽取式问答激增。
AI.motivation: 在保留原有 52 层骨干架构的前提下，以最低改造成本将英语中心的基座模型适配到印度语言场景，同时维持推理、指令跟随与工具使用能力，并探索印度语言能力与英语能力之间的权衡。
AI.method: 沿用 Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B 的 52 层骨干，仅更换词表、训练数据与后训练目标；将词表从 131,072 就地扩展至 163,072，新嵌入行由其上游分解初始化并先做预热再更新骨干；随后进行英印混合数据的持续预训练、高质量退火与 131,072 长度序列直接训练；后训练包含四个可验证任务环境的强化学习，并附两项未发布研究（限定范围的印度语言奖励、生成式判官与蒸馏修复）。
AI.result: 词表扩展使印度语言平均生育率降低 38.6%；RL 提升数学、研究生级科学与指令跟随，但印度语言抽取式问答退化，用英语作答比例由 8.7% 升至 91.7%，在目标文字上作答的条件准确率约翻倍（但基于自选子集）；26B-A4B 生成式判官在 RM-Bench 上优于 235B 参数模型，对其蒸馏可恢复 81% 被置换能力；发布模型相对同架构起点在印度语言聚合上 +5.2、英语保持 -1.7；未发布的印度语言感知分支为 +14.6 印度语言点、代价 5.4 英语点；计划中的 FP8 版本体积降至 32GB，32 项配对基准平均变化近零。
AI.conclusion: 词表扩展与持续预训练可高效提升印度语言能力，但 RL 奖励设计若缺乏语言约束会诱发语言漂移，需通过限定范围的印度语言奖励或蒸馏加以修复；该模型在印度语言增益与英语保持之间存在明确权衡，并有可落地的 FP8 量化路径。

title: In-Place Indic Tokenizer Expansion and Continual Pretraining of Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B
comment: Accepted at the GlobalSouthAI Workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: We adapted Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B for eight Indian languages without changing its backbone architecture. We expanded the vocabulary in place from 131,072 to 163,072 entries using continued byte-pair encoding and AdaptMix rebalancing, reducing tokens per word by 38.6%. We initialized new input and output rows by averaging their original constituent rows, then trained them on 90% Indic and 10% English text before updating the backbone. Continual pretraining then progressed through broad training, high-quality annealing, and long-context training over approximately 1.27 trillion tokens. The annealed checkpoint gained 12.9 points on the Indic MILU benchmark but lost 3.4 on English MMLU. We also report practical negative results. Direct token addition underperformed continued byte-pair encoding. AdamW weight decay changed rows intended to stay fixed. Perplexity on an Indic-heavy holdout did not select the learning rate that best preserved English performance.

AI.tldr: 在不改动主干结构的前提下，将Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B适配至8种印度语言：词表由131,072扩至163,072，续训约1.27万亿token，Indic MILU提升12.9分，但英文MMLU下降3.4分，并报告若干负面结果。
AI.motivation: 提升印度语言能力通常需要更强多语言支持，而重训或改架构成本高，因此作者希望在保持主干架构不变的情况下低成本扩展现有模型的印度语言覆盖，同时尽量保留英文能力。
AI.method: 采用Continued BPE与AdaptMix重平衡将词表从131,072原位扩展至163,072；新输入/输出行用其原始组成行取平均初始化，先在90% Indic + 10% English文本上训练新行，再更新主干；继续预训练分三阶段（广覆盖训练、高质量退火、长上下文训练），共约1.27万亿token。
AI.result: 每词token数减少38.6%；退火检查点在Indic MILU上提升12.9分，同时英文MMLU下降3.4分。负面结果：直接添加token不如Continued BPE；AdamW权重衰减会改变本应保持固定的行；以印度语为主的留出集困惑度无法选出最能保留英文性能的学习率。
AI.conclusion: 原位词表扩展加分阶段继续预训练可在不改主干的前提下显著增强印度语言表现，但存在英文能力回退；词表扩展方式、优化器正则项与模型选择指标均需谨慎处理，困惑度并非可靠的英文保持性代理指标。

title: VideoEvoHarness: Self Evolving Agent Harness from Unlabeled Videos for Video Understanding
summary: Video understanding agents rely on a harness to acquire evidence, use tools, and reason, but improving it requires substantial effort. Recent self evolution methods seek to optimize harnesses through execution feedback to reduce human intervention. However, existing methods often rely on annotated video questions and answers or focus on updating model parameters, leaving harness evolution from unlabeled videos underexplored. VideoEvoHarness jointly evolves a Questioner and a Solver harness from unlabeled videos with frozen model parameters. The Questioner constructs questions and computes reference answers directly from video memory records. Question quality assessments and Solver execution trajectories guide question generation policy revisions. The Solver supports evolving skills, strategies, hyperparameters, and tools using execution feedback. Executable strategies define workflows in code, reducing repeated interpretation of natural language instructions. Each round, candidate harnesses are compared on identical validation questions, with validated improvements retained for later use. Experiments on benchmarks and a dedicated benchmark question set, using videos disjoint from evolution videos, show higher overall accuracy than initially and transfer gains across backbones. Overall accuracy on this set also improves progressively across rounds. This supports our foundational framework for harness evolution from unlabeled videos, opening a promising direction for self evolving video agents. Code is available at https://github.com/Wei-Xin-Xu/VideoEvoHarness.

AI.tldr: VideoEvoHarness 提出从无标注视频中联合进化 Questioner 与 Solver 两个 harness 的框架，在冻结模型参数条件下提升视频理解 agent 性能。
AI.motivation: 视频理解 agent 依赖 harness 来获取证据、调用工具和推理，但人工改进 harness 成本高。现有自进化方法多依赖标注的视频问答数据，或侧重更新模型参数，对"从无标注视频进化 harness"这一方向探索不足。
AI.method: 在冻结模型参数下联合进化 Questioner 与 Solver harness。Questioner 直接从视频记忆记录中构造问题并计算参考答案；问题质量评估与 Solver 执行轨迹用于指导问题生成策略的修订。Solver 借助执行反馈进化技能、策略、超参数与工具，并以可执行代码定义策略工作流，减少对自然语言指令的重复解释。每轮在相同验证问题上比较候选 harness，保留经校验有效的改进。
AI.result: 在多个基准及专门的基准问题集上（所用视频与进化视频不相交），整体准确率高于初始版本，且增益可跨不同 backbone 迁移；在该问题集上的整体准确率随轮次逐步提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为从无标注视频进行 harness 进化提供了基础框架，为自进化视频 agent 开辟了有前景的方向，代码已开源。

title: From Acoustic Sensing to Physical Actions: A Comprehensive Survey of Security Risks in Edge-Deployed Audio LLM-Based Agents
summary: Audio Large Language Models (Audio LLMs) are embedded in agents for smart homes, vehicles, wearables, and embodied systems, where acoustic inputs can propagate from perception into persistent state and consequential execution. This setting extends security analysis beyond model behavior to the system conditions that determine how acoustic inputs can influence agent behavior and external actions. Existing surveys examine acoustic security, LLM-based agents, and edge deployment in isolation, leaving their security interactions in deployed Audio LLM-based agents insufficiently characterized. This survey introduces an Acoustic Sensing-to-Action (S2A) system model that traces these security implications along the path from acoustic sensing to external execution, while accounting for edge-cloud runtime and lifecycle transformation. We use the model to synthesize attacks, defenses, and evaluation methods across the acoustic, agent, and edge-system literature. The synthesis shows that security gaps can emerge within components and at the transitions between stages, where protections developed for one stage do not necessarily provide end-to-end assurance in the deployed system. These findings motivate security evaluation that follows acoustic influence from sensing to action across persistent state, system boundaries, and changing deployment conditions in real-world agents.

AI.tldr: 该综述提出“声学感知到动作（S2A）”系统模型，用于刻画部署式音频大语言模型智能体从声学感知到外部执行的端到端安全影响。
AI.motivation: 音频大语言模型被嵌入智能家居、车载、可穿戴与具身系统等智能体中，声学输入可经感知传播至持久状态与有后果的执行，使安全分析需从模型行为扩展到决定声学输入如何影响智能体行为及外部动作的系统条件。已有综述分别研究声学安全、基于大语言模型的智能体与边缘部署，未充分刻画其在部署式音频大语言模型智能体中的安全交互。
AI.method: 引入声学感知到动作（Acoustic Sensing-to-Action, S2A）系统模型，沿“声学感知—外部执行”路径追踪安全影响，并纳入边缘—云运行时与生命周期变换；据此综合声学、智能体与边缘系统文献中的攻击、防御与评估方法。
AI.result: 综合表明，安全缺口既可能出现在各组件内部，也可能出现在阶段之间的转换处；针对单一阶段开发的防护不必然在部署系统中提供端到端保障。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现推动开展面向真实世界智能体的安全评估：沿“声学影响到动作”的路径，跨越持久状态、系统边界及不断变化的部署条件进行跟踪。

title: A Decade of PhotoMappers: A Longitudinal Study of Crowdsourced Disaster Photos Geolocalization with Vision-Language Models and Geospatial Reasoning
summary: Crowdsourced disaster imagery provides timely, ground-level observations when conventional disaster mapping is delayed or incomplete, yet its geographic value depends on where observations are produced, how they are interpreted, and whether they can be reliably located as actionable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT). Using more than a decade of PhotoMappers, a crowdsourced disaster-mapping initiative, this study examines the changing geography of disaster information and asks how emerging GeoAI models compare with human geographic interpretation. We combine longitudinal spatial analysis with cross-view geolocalization using street view imagery (SVI) and remote sensing imagery (RSI), and evaluate vision-language models (VLMs) reasoning through 30 indicators spanning geographic cues and reasoning evidence. The results reveal a geographically and temporally uneven archive shaped by changing disaster types, Community Lifelines, and operational priorities. Integrating VGI, SVI, and RSI with Sinkhorn re-ranking achieves 40.90% R@1, 61.10% R@5, and 69.45% R@10, while yearly R@1 varies markedly from 25.00% to 65.07%. Geographic reasoning is similarly uneven: Qwen3.6-27B achieves an overall agreement of 67% compared with 51% for InternVL3-8B, with both models showing greater difficulty with localized and place-specific evidence than broad spatial configurations. We argue that the value of GeoAI lies less in replacing volunteered geographic interpretation than in complementing it, scaling candidate retrieval while retaining human judgment for ambiguous and consequential cases. This provides a pathway toward more human-centered and responsible GeoAI for disaster mapping. All data and code are openly available at https://github.com/bobleegogogo/PhotoMappers-VLM.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于十余年PhotoMappers众包灾害影像数据，结合纵向空间分析与跨视角地理定位（VGI+SVI+RSI，Sinkhorn重排），并评测视觉语言模型的地理推理能力，论证GeoAI应补充而非取代志愿者地理判读。
AI.motivation: 众包灾害影像可提供及时的地面观测，弥补传统灾害制图的延迟与不完整；但其地理价值取决于观测产生的位置、解读方式及能否可靠定位为可行动的地理空间情报（GEOINT），且需要评估新兴GeoAI模型与人类地理判读的差异。
AI.method: 采用PhotoMappers十余年众包灾害制图数据，开展纵向空间分析；结合街景影像（SVI）与遥感影像（RSI）进行跨视角地理定位，使用Sinkhorn重排；并以涵盖地理线索与推理证据的30项指标评测视觉语言模型（VLM）的地理推理，比较Qwen3.6-27B与InternVL3-8B。
AI.result: 档案在空间与时间上分布不均，受灾害类型、社区生命线（Community Lifelines）与运营优先级影响。融合VGI、SVI与RSI并采用Sinkhorn重排后达到R@1=40.90%、R@5=61.10%、R@10=69.45%，但年度R@1波动显著（25.00%–65.07%）。地理推理同样不均衡：Qwen3.6-27B总体一致率67%，InternVL3-8B为51%，两者对本地化、地点特定证据的处理均明显弱于宏观空间格局。
AI.conclusion: GeoAI的价值不在于取代志愿地理判读，而在于补充之：扩展候选检索规模，同时将模糊与高风险案例保留给人类判断，从而走向更以人为本、负责任的灾害制图GeoAI。数据与代码已公开。

title: From Candidate Tokens to Final Outcomes: Decoding Relative Long-Horizon Candidate Value from Reasoning Model Representations
summary: Large reasoning models generate reasoning trajectories token by token. At a given prefix, multiple next-token candidates may be plausible, yet shape subsequent reasoning and differ in their chances of leading to the correct answer. Whether these differences are reflected in internal representations remains unclear. To study this question, we define relative long-horizon candidate value to quantify within-prefix differences and construct the Reasoning Candidate-Token Value (RCTV) dataset, pairing mathematical reasoning prefixes with plausible next-token candidates and their empirical long-horizon candidate values. Using RCTV, we examine hidden states, multilayer perceptron outputs, and attention outputs at candidate positions with sparse linear probes. Experimental results provide evidence that relative long-horizon candidate value is linearly decodable from these representations at multiple layers. Candidate-value probes can also outperform probability- and embedding-based baselines. Furthermore, a controlled online intervention experiment shows that using the decoded signals to guide token selection during generation can improve the chances of eventual success. Our findings provide evidence that internal representations encode information about relative long-horizon candidate value, offering insights into how local candidate-level representations relate to long-horizon reasoning outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出相对长程候选价值（relative long-horizon candidate value）这一指标，并构建 RCTV 数据集，用稀疏线性探针证明该价值可从大推理模型的隐藏状态、MLP 输出和注意力输出中线性解码，且解码信号可用于在线干预以提升推理成功率。
AI.motivation: 大推理模型逐 token 生成推理轨迹，同一前缀下多个候选下一 token 可能都合理，但它们对后续推理走向和最终正确率的影响不同。这种候选间的长程价值差异是否被编码在模型内部表征中尚不清楚，本文旨在研究这一问题。
AI.method: 1) 定义相对长程候选价值，量化同一前缀内候选 token 的差异；2) 构建 RCTV 数据集，将数学推理前缀与合理的下一 token 候选及其经验长程候选价值配对；3) 在候选位置的隐藏状态、MLP 输出和注意力输出上训练稀疏线性探针进行解码；4) 与基于概率和嵌入的基线比较；5) 设计受控在线干预实验，用解码信号引导生成时的 token 选择。
AI.result: 相对长程候选价值在多个层级的内部表征中可线性解码；候选价值探针优于基于概率和嵌入的基线；在受控在线干预实验中，利用解码信号引导 token 选择可提高最终推理成功的概率。
AI.conclusion: 内部表征编码了关于相对长程候选价值的信息，说明局部候选级表征与长程推理结果之间存在关联，为理解推理模型的候选选择机制提供了证据。

title: OmniRSI: Taming Latent Diffusion for Unified Multimodal Remote Sensing Image Generation
comment: Under review. Code and datasets will be provided in the https://github.com/MiliLab/OmniRSI
summary: Multimodal remote sensing image generation emerges as a promising paradigm for recovering complete and complementary observations from heterogeneous and partially observed remote sensing data. However, existing methods predominantly depend on sensor-specific fine-tuning of natural image generation models, limiting unified multimodal generation capacity due to the absence of shared representations and robust conditioning mechanisms. To address these challenges, we propose OmniRSI, a unified multimodal remote sensing image generation model. Specifically, we develop a remote sensing-specific variational autoencoder that captures multimodal priors and promotes a locally smooth latent space for unified representation and robust reconstruction across diverse observed data. Building upon that, we fully adapt Stable Diffusion 3.5 with a ControlNet branch to support unified multimodal generation and translation conditioned on textual and visual cues. Besides, we devise a training-free cyclic latent alignment mechanism that iteratively enriches incomplete visual conditions with generated multimodal information, progressively improving guidance reliability while preserving observed measurements. We also construct RSI-MM, a large-scale dataset comprising 11.5M multi-resolution images with text annotations and partially paired data for training and evaluation. Extensive experiments verify that OmniRSI achieves superior performance in multimodal reconstruction, generation and translation.

AI.tldr: 提出OmniRSI统一多模态遥感图像生成模型，通过遥感专用VAE、ControlNet增强的SD3.5及无训练循环潜在对齐机制，实现多模态重建、生成与翻译，并构建RSI-MM大规模数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多依赖对自然图像生成模型的传感器特定微调，缺乏共享表示与稳健的条件机制，难以实现统一的多模态生成能力，无法从异构、部分观测的遥感数据中恢复完整互补的观测。
AI.method: 1) 设计遥感专用变分自编码器，捕获多模态先验并促进局部平滑的潜在空间，实现统一表示与稳健重建；2) 在Stable Diffusion 3.5上引入ControlNet分支进行充分适配，支持以文本和视觉线索为条件的统一多模态生成与翻译；3) 提出无需训练的循环潜在对齐机制，用生成的多模态信息迭代丰富不完整的视觉条件；4) 构建RSI-MM数据集，含1150万多分辨率图像、文本标注及部分配对数据。
AI.result: 大量实验验证OmniRSI在多模态重建、生成和翻译任务上均取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: OmniRSI为统一多模态遥感图像生成提供了有效方案，通过专用表示学习、稳健条件机制与循环潜在对齐，突破了传感器特定微调的限制，并借助RSI-MM数据集支撑训练与评测。

title: Sensitivity or Criterion? Measuring and Moving When Language Models Act
summary: Before an agent acts, it must decide whether action is warranted. A single accuracy cannot distinguish failure to recognize a warranted action from reluctance to act. Signal-detection theory separates sensitivity from criterion, but criteria estimated from authored binary labels depend on each benchmark's example mix. We introduce FlipAct, a diagnostic of tool use in physical states. A rule over annotated tool properties computes each answer and a graded evidence score, fixing the Yes/No boundary at zero across models. Questions form 2-by-2 quads that hold required knowledge fixed while the state flips. The slope of the fitted Yes-rate curve measures sensitivity; its crossing at one half measures criterion. Across 44 open models, sensitivity rises with size within a family, and its ranking agrees with three of four external when-to-act benchmarks. Models respond to evidence sign rather than magnitude, accepting actions that leave the state no better about as often as helpful ones. When Yes means act, most models are conservative across rephrasings; in some, this partly reflects a preference for No. Criterion is not determined by size. Activation steering shifts criterion with weights fixed; distillation from a model's own steered copy puts the shift into its weights without a significant sensitivity change. The distilled shift transfers to six external benchmarks, including two without Yes/No answers, while criterion-free AUC is preserved on the five benchmarks where it is available. Accuracy improves where models start conservative and declines or remains within error where they start permissive. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/flipact

AI.tldr: 提出 FlipAct 诊断框架，将"是否调用工具"的决策分解为敏感度（sensitivity）与判定标准（criterion），通过工具属性规则生成分级证据分数并将 Yes/No 边界固定为 0，用 2×2 状态翻转问题组分离二者；在 44 个开源模型上验证了敏感度随规模上升、标准与规模无关，并实现仅移动标准而不改变敏感度的权重级调控。
AI.motivation: 智能体行动前需判断行为是否合理，但单一准确率无法区分"未识别出应行动的情形"与"不愿行动"，二者性质截然不同。信号检测论虽能区分敏感度与判定标准，但从各基准的人工二元标签估计出的标准依赖于该基准的样本构成（正例比例），导致跨基准、跨模型不可比。因此需要一个能在固定知识要求下、跨模型统一判定边界、从而可分离测量敏感度与标准的诊断工具。
AI.method: 1) FlipAct：基于标注的工具属性规则计算答案，并给出分级证据分数，将 Yes/No 判定边界统一固定在 0，消除基准正例比例对标准估计的影响。2) 设计 2×2 四元问题组，在保持所需知识不变的前提下翻转物理状态。3) 对拟合的 Yes 率曲线，用斜率度量敏感度，用其 1/2 处交点度量判定标准。4) 采用激活引导（activation steering）在固定权重下移动标准；再通过从模型自身的"被引导副本"蒸馏，将该偏移写入权重并检验敏感度是否显著变化。5) 在 6 个外部基准（含 2 个无 Yes/No 答案者）上检验偏移迁移性，并在 5 个可计算 AUC 的基准上检查无标准指标是否保持。
AI.result: 在 44 个开源模型上：敏感度在同一系列内随规模上升，其排序与 4 个外部 when-to-act 基准中的 3 个一致；模型主要对证据的符号而非幅度作出响应，接受"使状态不变得更好"的行动的频率与接受有益行动相近。当 Yes 表示行动时，多数模型在多种改写下表现保守，部分模型保守部分源于对 No 的偏好。判定标准不随规模决定。激活引导可在权重不变时移动标准；自我蒸馏可将该偏移写入权重且不引起敏感度显著变化。蒸馏后的偏移可迁移到 6 个外部基准，其中 2 个不含 Yes/No 答案，且在 5 个可算 AUC 的基准上无标准指标 AUC 保持。准确率在模型原本保守时有提升，在原本偏宽松时下降或落在误差范围内。
AI.conclusion: 工具使用决策的"准确率"应被拆解为敏感度与判定标准两个正交维度，二者对模型规模的依赖截然不同，且可通过权重级手段（引导+蒸馏）单独调控标准而不损害敏感度与排序能力。这为诊断与校正智能体的"何时行动"行为提供了可迁移、可比、且不依赖标签构成的评估与干预路径。

title: Harnessing SPAD Noise: Test-Time Gated Attention for Indoor Depth Estimation
summary: Monocular depth estimation (MDE) has emerged as a cost-effective alternative to hardware-dependent 3D sensing modalities, yet predicting precise metric depth remains a persistent challenge due to intrinsic scale ambiguity, edge bleeding, and limited zero-shot generalization in unseen environments. Recent multi-modal approaches incorporate 1D/3D Single-Photon Avalanche Diode (SPAD) data to resolve these ambiguities, but they mainly treat SPAD noise as a harmful artifact required for denoising or leave the noise ignored. In this paper, we present an essentially different insight: native SPAD noise is an informative prior that implicitly encodes deterministic environmental characteristics. Driven by this paradigm shift, we introduce a novel, lightweight Test-Time Gated Attention framework by Harnessing SPAD Noise, therefore dubbed HSN. Tailored for indoor scenarios, HSN leverages the synergistic combination of 1D SPAD histograms and Gate Adapters (GAs). Through three complementary optimization phases, it generates channel-wise gated attention vectors to dynamically adjust encoder feature maps at inference time, effectively resolving ambiguous scale and boundary challenges without the heavy computational overhead or dense 3D modalities that other TTA methods suffer from. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world indoor benchmarks show that HSN achieves state-of-the-art metric depth accuracy in in-domain settings, while exhibiting even greater potential under zero-shot generalization to unfamiliar environments. Furthermore, interpretability analysis reveals that the proposed gated attention mechanism adaptively shifts attention toward deeper semantic layers under intensifying SPAD noise. Code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HSN框架，将SPAD原生噪声视为蕴含确定性环境特征的信息性先验，结合1D SPAD直方图与门控适配器，通过测试时门控注意力动态调整编码器特征，实现室内单目度量深度估计的SOTA精度与更强的零样本泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 单目深度估计(MDE)成本低，但受尺度模糊、边缘渗漏与零样本泛化差困扰。现有多模态方法引入1D/3D SPAD数据缓解歧义，却把SPAD噪声当作需去噪的有害噪声或直接忽略。作者提出相反洞见：原生SPAD噪声本身是编码环境确定性特征的信息性先验。
AI.method: 提出轻量级测试时门控注意力框架HSN，面向室内场景，融合1D SPAD直方图与门控适配器(Gate Adapters, GAs)。经三个互补优化阶段生成通道级门控注意力向量，在推理时动态调整编码器特征图，无需重计算开销或密集3D模态。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的真实室内基准上，HSN在同域设置下达到SOTA度量深度精度，在零样本泛化到陌生环境时表现更优。可解释性分析表明，随着SPAD噪声增强，门控注意力机制自适应地将注意力转向更深的语义层。
AI.conclusion: 将SPAD噪声重新定位为有用先验而非噪声伪影，是提升单目度量深度估计精度与泛化性的有效范式；轻量测试时门控注意力可在低开销下解决尺度与边界歧义，代码将公开。

title: Rethinking Supervision in Document Unwarping: A Self-consistent Flow-free Approach
summary: In recent years, the proliferation of smartphones has led to an upsurge in the digitization of document files via these portable devices. However, images captured by smartphones often suffer from distortions, thereby negatively affecting digital preservation and downstream applications. To address this issue, we introduce DRNet, a novel deep network for document image rectification. Our approach is based on three key designs. Firstly, we exploit the intrinsic geometric consistency inherent in document images to guide the learning process of distortion rectification. Secondly, we design a coarse-to-fine rectification network to leverage the representations derived from the distorted document image, thereby enhancing the rectification result. Thirdly, we propose a unique perspective for supervising the learning of rectification networks, where undistorted document images are employed for supervision, which is free of warping mesh as ground truth in existing methods. Technically, both low-level pixel alignment and high-level semantic alignment jointly contribute to the learning of the mapping relationship between deformed document images and distortion-free ones. We evaluate our method on the challenging DocUNet Benchmark dataset, where it sets a series of state-of-the-art records, demonstrating the superiority of our approach compared to existing learning-based solutions. Additionally, we conduct a comprehensive series of ablation experiments to further validate the effectiveness and merits of our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRNet深度网络用于文档图像畸变矫正，通过利用文档图像内在几何一致性、粗到细矫正网络以及以无畸变图像替代扭曲网格作为监督信号三项设计，在DocUNet基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 智能手机普及使便携设备文档数字化需求激增，但手机拍摄的文档图像常存在畸变，严重影响数字化保存与下游应用，因此需要有效的畸变矫正方法。
AI.method: DRNet包含三项关键设计：(1) 利用文档图像内在的几何一致性指导畸变矫正的学习；(2) 设计粗到细矫正网络，充分利用从畸变文档图像中提取的表示以增强矫正效果；(3) 提出新的监督视角，直接以无畸变文档图像作为监督，摆脱现有方法对扭曲网格真值的依赖。技术上通过低层像素对齐与高层语义对齐共同学习畸变图像到无畸变图像的映射关系。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的DocUNet Benchmark数据集上评估，DRNet刷新了一系列最优记录，优于现有基于学习的解决方案；并通过全面的消融实验进一步验证了方法的有效性与优势。
AI.conclusion: DRNet通过几何一致性引导、粗到细网络结构与免网格真值的监督方式，实现了文档图像畸变矫正的领先性能，为文档数字化提供了有效方案。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: Advancing Harmful Content Understanding via Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play
summary: Despite significant advances in language understanding, Large Language Models (LLMs) can still miss meaning hidden in plain sight, failing to identify harmful intent in expressions readily understood by humans. Malicious users exploit this gap by strategically disguising harmful content to evade automated moderation, posing a serious threat to online platform safety. The vulnerability reflects a fundamental cognitive asymmetry between human readers, who integrate contextual, phonetic, and visual cues to decipher the intent behind deliberate obfuscation, and text-based LLMs, which rely primarily on token sequences and have limited exposure to evolving evasions. To bridge this asymmetry, we propose PASP (Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play), which combines multi-perceptual views with adversarial self-play to improve understanding of harmful intent as evasions evolve. Specifically, PASP constructs textual, phonetic, and visual views of each input, preserving its original context while exposing pronunciation and glyph cues obscured in token space. During adversarial self-play, an attacker uses defender feedback to generate intent-preserving evasions, while the defender is trained using an intent-invariance reward to understand harmful intent across changing surface forms. Extensive experiments show that PASP reduces adaptive attack success rates by up to 73.71% and 74.49% on ChineseHarm-Bench and EvoHarmBench, respectively, preserves model capabilities with minimal degradation, and effectively interprets real-world evasive expressions in e-commerce.

AI.tldr: 为弥合人类与LLM在识别伪装有害意图上的认知不对称，提出PASP框架，融合文本、语音、字形多感知视图与对抗自博弈训练，显著降低自适应攻击成功率并保留模型能力。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽在语言理解上取得显著进展，但对"显而易见"的隐藏含义仍识别不足，难以察觉人类可轻易理解的有害意图。恶意用户通过策略性伪装内容规避自动审核，威胁平台安全。该脆弱性源于认知不对称：人类整合语境、语音与视觉线索来解读刻意混淆背后的意图，而基于文本的LLM主要依赖token序列，且对不断演变的规避手段暴露有限。
AI.method: 提出PASP（Perception-Aware Adversarial Self-Play），将多感知视图与对抗自博弈结合。具体地，为每个输入构建文本、语音、视觉三种视图，在保留原始语境的同时暴露token空间中被掩盖的发音与字形线索；在对抗自博弈中，攻击者利用防御者反馈生成保持意图的规避样本，防御者则通过意图不变性奖励进行训练，从而跨变化的表层形式理解有害意图。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，PASP在ChineseHarm-Bench和EvoHarmBench上分别将自适应攻击成功率降低最多73.71%和74.49%，模型能力仅出现极小退化，并能有效解读电商场景中的真实规避表达。
AI.conclusion: PASP通过多感知视图与对抗自博弈结合，有效缓解了人机之间的认知不对称，提升了LLM在规避手段持续演变下对有害意图的理解与鲁棒性，具有良好的实用价值。

title: EmoTrace-Bench: Diagnosing Emotional Expression in Text-to-Video Generation through Controlled Cues and Intensity
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) models are increasingly used to generate videos with targeted emotional expressions, yet existing evaluation methods mainly rely on holistic video-text alignment and provide limited insight into whether failures arise from target-emotion expression, intensity control, or specific affective cues. We introduce EmoTrace-Bench, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark that controls emotion intensity and selected affective cues in prompts and evaluates generated videos at multiple levels. EmoTrace-Bench contains 448 controlled prompts covering eight emotions, two intensity levels, and diverse cue conditions. Using 12 T2V models, we generate 5,376 videos and evaluate target-emotion presence, perceived intensity, and ten audiovisual dimensions of emotional expression with an automated evaluator calibrated and validated against human annotations on a subset of the data. Results reveal substantial differences across models and prompt designs. Prompts that explicitly describe a character's emotional reaction are followed more reliably than prompts that describe only events or scenes, whereas adding more affective cues or using more explicit cinematic audiovisual language does not consistently improve emotional generation. These results illustrate how aggregate alignment scores may overlook localized differences in target-emotion expression, intensity control, and cue realization. EmoTrace-Bench provides a traceable and interpretable framework for diagnosing emotional video generation without modifying existing generation pipelines, and we release the prompts and the automated evaluation rules.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmoTrace-Bench，一个细粒度诊断基准，通过控制情绪强度和情感线索来多层级评测文本到视频（T2V）模型的情感生成能力，并揭示整体对齐分数会掩盖局部差异。
AI.motivation: 现有 T2V 情感视频评测主要依赖整体视频-文本对齐分数，无法定位失败究竟源于目标情绪表达、强度控制还是特定情感线索的实现。因此需要一种可控、可追溯的细粒度诊断方法。
AI.method: 构建 EmoTrace-Bench：包含 448 条受控提示词，覆盖 8 种情绪、2 个强度等级和多种线索条件；使用 12 个 T2V 模型生成 5,376 个视频；设计自动评估器并在数据子集上经人工标注校准验证，从目标情绪存在性、感知强度和十项视听情感表达维度进行多层级评测。
AI.result: 模型与提示词设计之间存在显著差异：明确描述角色情感反应的提示词比仅描述事件或场景的提示词更可靠地被遵循；而增加情感线索或使用更明确的电影化视听语言并未稳定提升情感生成效果。
AI.conclusion: 整体对齐分数会忽略目标情绪表达、强度控制和线索实现方面的局部差异。EmoTrace-Bench 提供了一个无需修改现有生成流程、可追溯且可解释的情感视频生成诊断框架，并公开提示词与自动评测规则。

title: Semantic Saliency from Multi-Modal Large Language Model Scene Understanding Maps
summary: Image-computable low-level image saliency has shaped perceptual psychology and computer science, but is limited by its inability to capture human high-level cognitive factors that influence attention and eye movements. Here, we propose a new fully automated method to compute semantic saliency by quantifying each object's contribution to scene comprehension without fitting any parameters to human data: the Automated Scene Understanding Map (AUTO-SUM). AUTO-SUM automatically segments and removes individual objects from a scene, uses multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to describe the original and modified scenes, and measures the semantic similarity between these descriptions using text embeddings. We show that AUTO-SUM can predict which object is most important in a human-measured scene understanding map (H-SUM) estimated using human scene descriptions. We also show that AUTO-SUM can predict the object most fixated by human observers during free viewing and scene description tasks better than a low-level saliency model (GBVS, Itti-Koch), a saliency model trained based on human meaning ratings (Meaning Map), and comparable to DeepGaze, which is trained on human fixation data. We contend that AUTO-SUM can be used as a semantic saliency model that complements lower-level saliency models. Code are available at https://github.com/starsky77/AUTO-SUM-Source-Code .

AI.tldr: 提出AUTO-SUM，用多模态大模型量化物体对场景理解的贡献以计算语义显著度，无需拟合人类数据。
AI.motivation: 低层图像显著度模型无法捕捉影响注意力和眼动的人类高层认知因素。
AI.method: 自动分割并移除场景中各个物体，用MLLM描述原始与修改后场景，通过文本嵌入衡量描述间的语义相似度，从而量化每个物体的语义贡献。
AI.result: AUTO-SUM能预测人类场景理解图（H-SUM）中最重要的物体；在自由观看和场景描述任务中预测最受注视物体的表现优于GBVS、Itti-Koch和Meaning Map，与基于人类注视数据训练的DeepGaze相当。
AI.conclusion: AUTO-SUM可作为语义显著度模型，补充低层显著度模型。

title: AlphaPilot: Multi-Turn Tool-Using LLM Agents for Adaptive Alpha Mining with Reinforcement Learning
summary: Formulaic alpha mining seeks interpretable expressions that rank assets by future returns. The task is challenging because it demands simultaneous processing of unstructured market descriptions, historical data, and quantitative evaluation of candidate factors, yet most existing methods exploit only a subset of these signals. We introduce AlphaPilot, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains multi-turn tool-using LLM agents for adaptive alpha mining. The agent conditions on market descriptions, proposes factor expressions, queries real-data evaluator feedback, and updates a retained factor pool across turns. This design jointly leverages market text, LLM financial knowledge, real data, and evaluation feedback. At inference time, AlphaPilot performs day-by-day search and pool updates to adapt to shifting market regimes. Across three independent runs in out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, AlphaPilot achieves mean total returns of 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86, respectively. It attains the highest mean total return, Sharpe, and RankIC among the evaluated methods on both universes.

AI.tldr: AlphaPilot是一个强化学习框架，训练多轮工具调用的LLM智能体实现自适应因子挖掘，在CSI300和CSI500回测中取得最高总收益、夏普比率和RankIC。
AI.motivation: 公式化因子挖掘任务需要同时处理非结构化市场描述、历史数据和候选因子的量化评估，但现有多数方法仅利用其中部分信号。
AI.method: 提出AlphaPilot，通过强化学习训练多轮工具调用的LLM智能体：智能体以市场描述为条件提出因子表达式，查询真实数据评估器反馈，并在多轮中更新保留因子池；推理时逐日搜索并更新因子池以自适应市场状态变化。
AI.result: 在CSI300和CSI500样本外滚动回测的三次独立运行中，平均总收益分别为42.93%和54.19%，平均夏普比率为2.46和2.86，在两个股票池中均取得最高平均总收益、夏普比率和RankIC。
AI.conclusion: AlphaPilot联合利用市场文本、LLM金融知识、真实数据和评估反馈，能够自适应地挖掘可解释因子并持续适应市场状态变化。

title: Concept Representations in Vector Space: Quantifying Sharedness and Idiosyncrasy of Meaning
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures. Preprint under review at Open Mind: Discoveries in Cognitive Science. Data, code and pre-registration: https://osf.io/dc6an
summary: Concepts are the basic units through which we navigate the world and communicate meaning. But do you and I really mean the same thing when we think or speak about a concept? The present study develops a measurement framework for modeling and analyzing interindividual variation in concept representations through sentence embeddings, dense vector representations mapping entire utterances into a shared geometric space. The framework is developed in a theoretical argument and validated, demonstrated, and subjected to robustness checks in a pre-registered study. Short personal definitions, elicited from $N = 125$ participants, are encoded as sentence embeddings and submitted pairwise to a crossed random effects model yielding two concept-level quantities: sharedness ($S_b$), the expected dissimilarity between two randomly drawn individuals, and idiosyncrasy ($I_b$), the person-specific share of total dyadic variance. Two validity tests support the approach: the embedding space fully recovers concept and domain organization from participant definitions even with the target word excluded, and a parameter-free classifier achieves 0.630 accuracy in a within-participant extensional prediction task against a chance baseline of 0.500 and a consistency ceiling of 0.893. The framework finds theoretically interpretable variation in $S_b$ and establishes $I_b$ as a reliable source of dyadic variance across concepts. Results replicate across three encoders varying in architecture and capacity, providing a reproducible and scalable instrument for the empirical study of meaning variation.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个基于句嵌入的测量框架，用于建模和分析个体间概念表征的变异，并通过预注册研究验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 概念是我们理解和交流意义的基本单位，但不同个体对同一概念的理解是否存在差异尚需量化。现有研究缺乏可扩展、可复现的工具来刻画个体间概念表征的变异。
AI.method: 将125名被试提供的简短个人定义编码为句嵌入，成对输入交叉随机效应模型，得到两个概念层面的量：共享度（S_b，即随机两名个体间的期望不相似度）和特异性（I_b，即个体特有的二元方差占比）。
AI.result: 嵌入空间在排除目标词的情况下仍能完整恢复概念与领域组织；无参数分类器在被试内扩展预测任务中达到0.630准确率（随机基线0.500，一致性上限0.893）。S_b呈现理论可解释的变异，I_b是可靠的二元方差来源，结果在三种不同架构与容量的编码器上均能复现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为意义变异的实证研究提供了一个可复现、可扩展的测量工具。

title: Structured Stateful Relational Scripts with a High-Quality Dataset for Multi-Shot Audio-Visual Video Generation
summary: Coherent multi-shot audio-visual video generation requires maintaining consistent identities while depicting evolving states and coordinating sounds across shot boundaries. Although dense captions describe individual shots in detail, they rarely specify which entities persist, how their states change, or which entities and actions produce sounds. To address this limitation, we propose Structured Stateful Relational Scripts (SSRS), a textual supervision representation that separates persistent entity and voice identities from shot-specific visual and auditory states. SSRS explicitly encodes sound-source bindings and temporal relations, while a global audio-visual event sequence connects local actions and sounds, including events that continue across shot boundaries. We further introduce MSAV-Script-100K, a large-scale dataset of curated multi-shot audio-visual videos paired with detailed SSRS annotations, enabling models to learn identity persistence, state transitions, and event continuity from structured supervision. Experiments demonstrate improvements in cross-shot consistency, adherence to specified state changes, and audio-visual alignment, highlighting the effectiveness of our SSRS and MSAV-Script-100K for coherent multi-shot audio-visual generation. Our proposed dataset is available at \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/shenlehan/MSAV-Script-100K}{MSAV-Script-100K}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSRS（结构化状态化关系脚本）文本监督表示与MSAV-Script-100K数据集，用于实现连贯的多镜头音视频生成。
AI.motivation: 多镜头音视频生成需在跨镜头切换时保持身份一致、刻画状态演变并协调声音。现有密集字幕虽能描述单镜头细节，却很少指明哪些实体持续存在、状态如何变化，以及哪些实体和动作产生声音，缺乏结构化监督。
AI.method: 提出SSRS表示：将持久存在的实体与声音身份，同镜头特定的视觉与听觉状态相分离；显式编码声源绑定与时间关系；并引入全局音视频事件序列，连接局部动作与声音，包括跨越镜头边界延续的事件。同时构建MSAV-Script-100K大规模数据集，包含多镜头音视频与详细SSRS标注。
AI.result: 实验表明，方法在跨镜头一致性、对指定状态变化的遵循度以及音视频对齐方面均取得提升，验证了SSRS与MSAV-Script-100K对连贯多镜头音视频生成的有效性。
AI.conclusion: SSRS与MSAV-Script-100K为多镜头音视频生成提供了结构化监督方案，可有效提升身份持久性、状态转换与事件连续性，数据集已公开。

title: REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
summary: Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis. We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

AI.tldr: REPRO：纯黑盒进化式对抗提示优化框架，用7B反思模型单卡驱动，在36个目标模型上单轮达到100%攻击成功率（中位24次查询），但该数值受自评评审与提前停止协议限定。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队方法存在三类局限：需要生产环境不可得的高权限访问；依赖针对单一模型人工设计的模板；仅优化单一目标而缺乏群体层面的多样性。因此需要一种纯黑盒、无需人工模板、且具备种群多样性的对抗提示发现方法。
AI.method: REPRO（Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization）为纯黑盒框架，由单个消费级GPU上运行的压缩开源7B反思模型全程驱动，通过进化优化搜索对抗提示。引入两项新机制并通过组件消融单独验证：一是语义交叉（semantic crossover），即由LLM引导的多父代重组算子；二是基于Thompson采样的贝叶斯策略选择，其先验由结构化失败分析提供信息。评测覆盖AdvBench、JailbreakBench、HarmBench与11个家族共36个目标模型。
AI.result: 在本协议下，REPRO对每个被评测目标均实现单轮100%攻击成功率，每个行为的中位目标查询数为24次。覆盖目标包括GPT-5-nano、Claude-3.5-Sonnet、Gemini-2.5-Pro、Grok-4.1等。但该数值受两点协议限定：一是优化过程中给候选打分的评审同时也是报告ASR的来源（自评）；二是搜索一旦被接受即停止，因此ASR反映的是在迭代预算内搜索是否成功，而非固定预算下的成功率。所有基线数据均转录自其原始论文，使用的评审、预算与模型版本各不相同。
AI.conclusion: 论文将结果定位为"单一协议下的模型覆盖目录"，而非方法间的头对头排名，并在正文中详细讨论自评评审与提前停止这两项限定条件。

title: SARATHI: Decoupled Data-Free Probing and Adaptive Reconstruction for Structured LLM Pruning
summary: Structured pruning reduces the inference cost of large language models (LLMs) by permanently removing neurons and weight rows, yielding dense, hardware-agnostic speedup. Existing post-training methods couple neuron selection and weight reconstruction through a shared calibration dataset, introducing domain bias and out-of-memory failures at high sparsity. We propose SARATHI, a framework that decouples these two stages. A data-free \emph{NMF Residual Subspace Probe} scores neurons using intrinsic weight geometry, without accessing any calibration data, and carries a formal connection to Robust PCA. \emph{Adaptive OBS} then reconstructs the pruned weights with a localized calibration batch, operating in $\mathcal{O}(d^2)$ peak memory per layer and eliminating the global memory bottleneck of coupled methods. A \emph{Bias Shift Compensation} step corrects systematic activation drift in post-LayerNorm architectures that would otherwise cause perplexity collapse at high sparsity. Experiments across six models from two architecture families (gated and non-gated FFN) at 15--40\% sparsity show that SARATHI achieves competitive perplexity and matches or exceeds existing structured pruning baselines on zero-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: SARATHI 通过解耦神经元选择与权重重建，实现无数据神经元评分与低内存结构化剪枝，在高稀疏度下保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有结构化剪枝的后训练方法将神经元选择与权重重建耦合在同一校准数据集上，导致领域偏差，并在高稀疏度下出现内存溢出。
AI.method: 提出 SARATHI 框架：用无数据的 NMF Residual Subspace Probe 基于权重内在几何进行神经元评分，并与 Robust PCA 建立理论联系；再用 Adaptive OBS 结合局部校准批次重建权重，将每层峰值内存降至 O(d²)；最后用 Bias Shift Compensation 修正 post-LayerNorm 架构中的系统性激活漂移。
AI.result: 在两个架构家族（门控与非门控 FFN）的六个模型上，于 15–40% 稀疏度下取得有竞争力的困惑度，并在零样本准确率上达到或超过现有结构化剪枝基线。
AI.conclusion: SARATHI 通过解耦神经元选择与权重重建，缓解领域偏差与内存瓶颈，并有效抑制高稀疏度下的困惑度崩溃，为结构化剪枝提供了高效且硬件友好的方案。

title: Semantically Steerable Image Tokenization
summary: Adaptive image tokenizers compress an image into a variable number of tokens matched to its complexity, and recent work makes this allocation controllable: conditioned on a target reconstruction error, the tokenizer itself decides how many tokens an image needs. However, the fidelity measure guiding this allocation shapes which aspects of the image are preserved under compression. The pixel-wise error used in prior work is blind to the spatial structure that carries an image's meaning, and under heavy compression such tokenizers are prone to abruptly discarding tokens that encode essential content. We introduce GIST (Guided Image Semantic Tokenizer), an adaptive tokenizer that can be steered toward a requested semantic fidelity. Its token allocation is jointly controlled by pixel-level and semantic target errors, with semantic error measured in the feature space of a frozen DINOv3 encoder. This joint control enables semantic protection: with the semantic target fixed at zero, the reconstruction target can be relaxed to discard pixel detail while preserving what the image depicts. In a controlled comparison on ImageNet-100, GIST outperforms its pixel-controlled counterpart KARL at every token count, with up to $30\%$ lower LPIPS and $37\%$ lower DreamSim. On average, lowering its semantic target reduces LPIPS $2\times$ faster per token than lowering the reconstruction target, and up to $5\times$ in the low-token regime. Semantic fidelity is thus an effective control signal for adaptive tokenization: it lets a tokenizer see, and so preserve, what an image depicts.

AI.tldr: 提出 GIST，一种以语义保真度为控制信号的自适应图像分词器，通过像素级与语义目标误差联合控制 token 分配，在低 token 数下显著优于像素控制的 KARL。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应分词器虽可按目标重建误差控制 token 数量，但所用逐像素误差对承载图像含义的空间结构不敏感；在重度压缩下容易突然丢弃编码关键内容的 token。因此需要一种能感知并保护语义内容的分配准则。
