AI.method: GIST（Guided Image Semantic Tokenizer）的 token 分配由像素级目标误差与语义目标误差共同控制，其中语义误差在冻结的 DINOv3 编码器特征空间中度量。该联合控制实现语义保护：将语义目标固定为零时，可放宽重建目标以丢弃像素细节而保留图像所描绘的内容。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet-100 的可控对比中，GIST 在所有 token 数量下均优于像素控制的 KARL，LPIPS 最多降低 30%，DreamSim 最多降低 37%。平均而言，每个 token 下降低语义目标使 LPIPS 下降的速度是降低重建目标的 2 倍，在低 token 区间可达 5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 语义保真度是自适应分词的有效控制信号，使分词器能够"看见"并因此保留图像所描绘的内容。

title: GNFormer: Gaussian Neural Field Transformer for Efficient Camera-based Occupancy Prediction
comment: The code will be released in https://github.com/GCChen97/gnformer_occ
summary: Camera-based occupancy prediction provides geometric and semantic scene understanding for robot perception and has been adopted in autonomous vehicle and UAV perception systems. Gaussian primitives offer a promising alternative by potentially representing only occupied regions, thereby concentrating computation and representational capacity where needed and reducing wasted computation and memory in empty space. However, existing Gaussian-based methods suffer from poor primitive utilization, as ineffective training objectives leave some Gaussians in empty space, while the limited expressiveness of Gaussian functions restricts their ability to model complex shapes. To address these limitations, we propose a novel 3D representation, Gaussian Neural Field (GNF), which can accurately map voxel positions to semantic occupancies. In GNF, Gaussians and a neural network jointly parameterize the field, where the Gaussians define its spatial support and provide features for neural decoding, while the neural network enables more expressive occupancy modeling than Gaussian functions alone. We further develop the Gaussian Neural Field Transformer (GNFormer), a streamlined and flexible method that predicts GNFs for camera-based occupancy prediction. Across Occ-ScanNet, SSCBench-KITTI-360, and nuScenes-SurroundOcc benchmarks, GNFormer achieves the highest IoU and mIoU and the fastest inference among the compared single-frame methods. In the experiments, GNFormer can represent indoor and outdoor scenes with only 256 and 1024 Gaussians, respectively, substantially fewer primitives than prior Gaussian-based methods. The code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Gaussian Neural Field (GNF) 3D表示及其预测器GNFormer，解决现有高斯方法基元利用率低与表达能力不足的问题，在多个占据预测基准上取得最高IoU/mIoU与最快单帧推理速度。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的占据预测需要几何与语义场景理解。高斯基元有潜力仅表示被占据区域，从而集中计算与表示能力、减少空白空间的浪费；但现有高斯方法存在两个问题：(1) 训练目标不佳导致部分高斯落在空白空间，基元利用率低；(2) 高斯函数表达能力有限，难以建模复杂形状。
AI.method: 提出GNF：由高斯与神经网络联合参数化的3D表示，高斯定义场的空间支撑并提供特征供神经解码，神经网络实现比单纯高斯函数更具表达力的占据建模，可精确将体素位置映射到语义占据。进一步提出Gaussian Neural Field Transformer (GNFormer)，一个简洁灵活的方法，从相机输入预测GNF，用于占据预测。
AI.result: 在Occ-ScanNet、SSCBench-KITTI-360和nuScenes-SurroundOcc基准上，GNFormer在所比较的单帧方法中取得最高IoU和mIoU以及最快推理速度。实验中，GNFormer仅用256个（室内）和1024个（室外）高斯即可表示场景，基元数量远少于先前基于高斯的方法。
AI.conclusion: GNF与GNFormer通过高斯与神经网络联合参数化提升了基元利用率与建模表达能力，在精度与效率上均优于现有单帧相机占据预测方法；代码将开源。

title: A Step in the Right Place: Understanding and Optimizing Timestep Placement in Continuous Diffusion Language Models
summary: Continuous diffusion language models represent an emerging paradigm for language modeling. They generate text in parallel by iteratively refining continuous representations and mapping them back to tokens through a decoder. However, realizing the efficiency advantage of parallel generation requires maintaining generation quality with only a few denoising steps. Even when the number of steps is fixed, their placement along the denoising trajectory remains flexible. In this paper, we demonstrate that changing timestep placement alone can substantially alter the final latent representations and thereby affect the decoded token distributions. Building on these findings, we introduce StepTune, an algorithm that searches for timestep placements that improve generation quality. The search is conducted on a small calibration set and guided by a language-aware objective, with the model and sampling budget fixed. Once calibrated, the timestep placement is fixed and reused across inputs. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements in unconditional generation perplexity and conditional task metrics across all evaluated sampling budgets. In particular, StepTune enables 16-step sampling with a frozen model to outperform its native 64-step baseline on both XSum summarization and WMT14 translation and reduces end-to-end latency by approximately $3.8\times$. These results establish timestep placement as a practical means of improving the quality-efficiency trade-off in continuous diffusion language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StepTune，通过在小规模校准集上搜索去噪轨迹的时间步放置方案（timestep placement），在不改变模型与采样预算的前提下提升连续扩散语言模型的生成质量与效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 连续扩散语言模型通过迭代精炼连续表示并解码为token来并行生成文本，其效率优势依赖在少量去噪步数下仍保持生成质量。即便步数固定，时间步在去噪轨迹上的放置仍具灵活性，但这一自由度的作用此前未被充分研究。
AI.method: 作者首先证明仅改变时间步放置就会显著改变最终隐表示，进而影响解码后的token分布。基于此提出 StepTune：在固定模型与采样预算下，于小规模校准集上，以语言相关目标为引导，搜索能提升生成质量的时间步放置方案；校准完成后该放置方案被固定并在所有输入间复用。
AI.result: 在全部评估的采样预算下，无条件生成的困惑度与条件任务指标均获得一致提升。特别地，StepTune 使冻结模型以16步采样在 XSum 摘要与 WMT14 翻译上均超过其原生64步基线，并将端到端延迟降低约3.8倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，时间步放置是改善连续扩散语言模型质量—效率权衡的一种实用手段。

title: UMAS3D: Unified Mask-Free 3D Editing with Region-Adaptive Source Preservation
summary: 3D editing aims to modify an existing 3D asset according to user intent while preserving geometry and appearance outside the intended edit region. Existing methods often rely on task-specific training, source-3D inversion, or external 3D masks, and lack a unified framework for diverse editing conditions and tasks. We propose UMAS3D, a unified 3D editing framework that is training-free, inversion-free, and free from external 3D masks. UMAS3D converts text, bounding boxes, reference images, and their combinations into common target-view guidance, after which addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing share the same downstream 3D generation process. Our key insight is to couple online edit-region estimation with region-aware source preservation. Mask-Free Adaptive Region Modeling (MARM) initializes an Edit/Keep prior from source-target visual differences and progressively refines it as the target structure evolves, while Source-Guided Preservation Steering (SGPS) constrains the current Keep-region states to retain source geometry and appearance without suppressing target-driven changes. Experiments show that UMAS3D supports addition, deletion, modification, appearance, and pose editing while effectively preserving unedited source content. These advances make UMAS3D a unified framework for flexible and source-preserving 3D editing across diverse editing conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出 UMAS3D，一个无需训练、无需反演、无需外部3D掩码的统一3D编辑框架，将文本、边界框、参考图及其组合转化为共同的目标视角引导，实现加、删、改、外观与姿态编辑共用同一生成流程。
AI.motivation: 现有3D编辑方法依赖任务特定训练、源3D反演或外部3D掩码，缺乏面向多样编辑条件与任务的统一框架。
AI.method: UMAS3D 将多种编辑条件统一为共同的目标视角引导；核心是耦合在线编辑区域估计与区域感知源保持：MARM 从源-目标视觉差异初始化 Edit/Keep 先验，并随目标结构演化逐步细化；SGPS 约束当前 Keep 区域状态以保留源几何与外观，同时不抑制目标驱动的变化。
AI.result: 实验表明 UMAS3D 支持添加、删除、修改、外观和姿态编辑，并能有效保持未编辑的源内容。
AI.conclusion: UMAS3D 为多样编辑条件下灵活且保持源内容的3D编辑提供了统一框架。

title: Apertus 1.5: From Open Text Models to Open Multimodal Reasoners
summary: Language models are becoming infrastructure, and infrastructure built in the open, by public institutions, on documented data, is the alternative to dependence on a few providers; Apertus shows this is viable at scale. Apertus 1.5 extends the fully open Apertus family from text to multimodal reasoning. Continued pretraining of the Apertus 1.0 models, on 4T additional tokens for the 8B and 2T for the 70B, adds image and audio understanding and extends the context window fourfold to 262,144 tokens; multimodality enters through the tokenizer, the language-model head remains restricted to text, and the architecture is unchanged. Supervised finetuning, long-context finetuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and preference alignment complete the released models. Thinking is a flag of the chat template rather than a separate model, and lifts mathematical reasoning by up to 20 points on the 8B model. The released models improve over their predecessors on nearly every benchmark; among fully open models of its class, the 8B leads on knowledge, instruction following, and cultural benchmarks, and its instruction following surpasses all compared models, including open-weight ones. On image and audio understanding, a first for the family, the models are competitive with fully open multimodal models, strongest on document understanding and long-form and lower-resource speech recognition, while specialized vision and audio models remain ahead on perception and transcription of English and other high-resource languages. As in Apertus 1.0, we train only on openly available data, respect crawler opt-outs retroactively, and exclude restrictively licensed material. We release the model weights, data preparation and training recipes, and evaluation suites under permissive licenses; openness extends to values, with the Apertus charter guiding alignment stages published alongside the models.

AI.tldr: Apertus 1.5 将完全开放的语言模型家族从纯文本扩展至多模态推理，通过持续预训练、扩大上下文至262K token并引入图像与音频理解，同时保持架构不变，在多项基准上超越前代并对全开放同类模型保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型正成为基础设施，而由公共机构基于公开文档数据在开放环境中构建的基础设施，可替代对少数供应商的依赖；Apertus 证明这种模式在大规模下可行。本文旨在将完全开放的 Apertus 家族从文本扩展至多模态推理，进一步验证开放基础设施的可行性。
AI.method: 对 Apertus 1.0 的 8B 与 70B 模型做持续预训练（分别增加 4T 与 2T token），加入图像与音频理解，将上下文窗口扩展四倍至 262,144 token；多模态通过 tokenizer 引入，语言模型 head 仍限于文本，架构保持不变。随后进行监督微调、长上下文微调、可验证奖励的强化学习与偏好对齐。Thinking 作为 chat template 的开关而非独立模型。训练仅使用公开可用数据，追溯尊重爬虫 opt-out，排除限制性许可材料。
AI.result: 发布模型在几乎所有基准上优于前代；在同级别完全开放模型中，8B 在知识、指令遵循与文化基准上领先，其指令遵循超越所有对比模型（包括开放权重模型）。在图像与音频理解上（家族首次），模型与完全开放多模态模型相当，在文档理解及长篇幅、低资源语音识别上最强，但专用视觉与音频模型在英语及高资源语言的感知与转录上仍领先。Thinking 开关使 8B 模型的数学推理最多提升 20 分。
AI.conclusion: Apertus 1.5 证明以公开数据、公共机构主导的完全开放方式，可在规模化条件下构建具竞争力的多模态推理模型；开放不仅限于模型权重，还延伸至数据准备与训练配方、评测套件（宽松许可发布）以及指导对齐阶段的 Apertus 章程所体现的价值观。

title: An Interpretable Linguistically-Grounded Analysis of Scene Saliency in Movie Screenplays
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026 Main Track, Long Paper
summary: We investigate the factors affecting salience in movie screenplay by posing two research questions: 1. {\em Does Uniform Information Density (UID) predict salient scenes?} 2. {\em What other linguistic properties distinguish salient scenes from non-salient background?} We answer both questions through a controlled corpus study on the MENSA corpus, paired with a Linguistically-Grounded Salience Model (LGSM), a dual-stream classifier that fuses a frozen BERT encoder with explicit linguistic features through adaptive gating. The UID picture is layered in long-form discourse. Per-scene UID summaries carry no independent signal once length is controlled, but at the token level salient scenes match non-salient material in the bulk while specifically suppressing the rarest, hardest-to-predict tokens in the upper tail. UID therefore lives at the within-scene token level rather than as a per-scene aggregate. Salient scenes also show a moderate and sustained cast of central characters (following an inverted-U pattern), strong third-person usage, syntactically simpler language, and more abstract vocabulary about motivation and conflict. LGSM exploits this signature and improves recall on salient scenes over a strong semantic baseline while yielding better downstream summaries.

AI.tldr: 本文基于MENSA语料库，探究影视剧本中"显著性"（salience）的语言学成因，提出两个研究问题：统一信息密度（UID）能否预测显著场景，以及其他哪些语言特征能区分显著场景与背景。作者构建了融合冻结BERT编码器与显式语言学特征的双流分类器LGSM（通过自适应门控融合），发现UID效应体现在场景内token层面而非场景级聚合层面，显著场景具有中心人物稳定出场（倒U型）、强第三人称使用、句法更简单、词汇更抽象等特征，LGSM由此提升了显著场景召回率与下游摘要质量。
AI.motivation: 探究影视剧本中"显著性"（即哪些场景对叙事更重要）的语言学决定因素，检验统一信息密度（UID）假说能否解释显著场景，并寻找其他能区分显著场景与背景场景的语言学属性，以服务于剧本理解与摘要等下游任务。
AI.method: 在MENSA语料库上开展受控语料研究，并构建Linguistically-Grounded Salience Model（LGSM）——一个双流分类器，将冻结的BERT编码器与显式语言学特征通过自适应门控（adaptive gating）进行融合，用于预测场景显著性。
AI.result: 1）UID在长文本篇章中呈现分层效应：在控制长度后，场景级UID汇总无独立预测信号；但在token层面，显著场景与非显著材料在主体分布上相似，只是在分布上尾（最稀有、最难预测的token）上被特异性地抑制，说明UID效应存在于场景内token层级而非场景级聚合。2）显著场景还表现出：中心人物以适度且持续的规模出现（呈倒U型模式）、强第三人称使用、句法更简单、词汇更抽象（涉及动机与冲突）。LGSM利用这一特征签名，在显著场景召回率上优于强语义基线，并产生更好的下游摘要。
AI.conclusion: UID对显著性的预测作用体现在场景内token层级而非场景级聚合层面；显著场景具有可辨识的多维语言学特征签名；所提LGSM模型能有效利用这些特征，在显著场景识别召回率与下游摘要质量上均优于强语义基线，证明显式语言学特征与神经语义表征的融合对剧本显著性建模具有价值。

title: ELECT: Settling Identity Before Rendering for Scalable Story Visualization
summary: Training-free story visualization without reference images must preserve recurring entities across frames while scaling to long narratives. Existing methods typically maintain consistency by conditioning each frame on other frames of the same story, coupling generation time, VRAM, or both to story length. We introduce ELECT, which instead settles cross-frame identity before final rendering through a language-guided scene-entity mapping and stationary anchors elected from the model's own drafts. This makes the per-frame cost of the final rendering pass independent of story length. Joint attention exceeds 96 GB of VRAM at 32 scenes, whereas ELECT remains at 8.3 s per frame and under 20 GB VRAM from 10 to 1000 scenes. On the Story50 long-story benchmark, ELECT reaches 0.833 average Character Consistency Similarity (aCCS), compared with 0.826 for ten-round refinement, at one seventh of its generation cost, with lower text alignment (0.327 vs. 0.340). At 1000 scenes, to our knowledge, the first evaluation of training-free story visualization at this length, ELECT exceeds ten-round refinement by 0.017 aCCS and the nearest flat-cost baseline by 0.091, while also surpassing refinement in text alignment at one twenty-fourth of its generation time. These results show that long-horizon consistency need not require increasingly expensive inter-frame conditioning as stories grow.

AI.tldr: ELECT 提出一种免训练故事可视化框架，通过语言引导的场景-实体映射与取自模型自身草图的静态锚点在最终渲染前确定跨帧身份，使每帧渲染成本与故事长度无关，可在 1000 场景下保持恒定显存与耗时。
AI.motivation: 免训练、无参考图的故事可视化需在跨帧保持复现实体一致性，同时扩展到长叙事。现有方法依赖同故事其他帧作为条件，导致生成时间、显存或二者随故事长度耦合增长，难以扩展。
AI.method: ELECT 不在渲染阶段做帧间条件耦合，而是在最终渲染前先确定跨帧身份：利用语言引导的场景-实体映射，并从模型自身生成的草图中“选举”出静态锚点（stationary anchors），以此作为身份约束。最终渲染的逐帧开销因此与故事长度无关。
AI.result: 在 32 场景时联合注意力需超过 96 GB 显存，而 ELECT 在 10 至 1000 场景下保持每帧 8.3 秒、显存低于 20 GB。Story50 长故事基准上 aCCS 为 0.833，对比十轮细化的 0.826，生成成本仅为其七分之一，文本对齐略低（0.327 对 0.340）。在 1000 场景（据称首个该长度的免训练故事可视化评测）中，ELECT 的 aCCS 超十轮细化 0.017、超最优恒定成本基线 0.091，并以二十四分之一的生成时间在文本对齐上也超过细化方法。
AI.conclusion: 长程一致性不必依赖随故事增长而愈发昂贵的帧间条件。ELECT 证明通过在渲染前确立实体身份并采用静态锚点，可实现成本与故事长度解耦的免训练故事可视化。

title: A Plausible Future Is Not a Causal Future: Can Video Models Generate How the World Unfolds?
summary: Large-scale video generation models are increasingly viewed as a promising path toward world models, yet their ability to capture causally coherent physical dynamics remains poorly understood. Existing evaluations largely emphasize visual quality, prompt adherence, or broad physical plausibility, leaving open whether a model can faithfully realize a complete causal cascade, in which an initiating event propagates through causally dependent interactions to a terminal outcome. We introduce CausalCascade, a simulator-grounded benchmark centered on 50 event-rich Blender scenes with structured event graphs, graph-grounded diagnostic VQA, three levels of future-event specification, and 2,832 controlled counterfactual variants, and use it to evaluate nine image-to-video models with complementary motion-, event-, and counterfactual-level diagnostics. Across the evaluated models, generated motion is more reliably localized spatially than realized with correct spatiotemporal evolution, while richer future-event specification improves event recovery but leaves physical realization limited. Counterfactual evaluation further reveals weak selective responsiveness to physical interventions, while most audited failures are foundational, arising at scene consistency or event occurrence. Together, these results position causal cascade generation as a process-level test of world modeling and highlight the need to jointly recover the intended future, faithfully realize its physical evolution, selectively respond to physical interventions, and maintain a coherent physical world over time. Code and dataset are available at https://github.com/SJTU-DeepDeltaLab/CausalCascade .

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CausalCascade，一个基于仿真器（Blender）的基准，用于从因果级联角度评估视频生成模型的世界建模能力，包含50个事件丰富场景、结构化事件图、诊断性VQA、三级未来事件指定方式及2,832个反事实变体，并据此评估了九个图生视频模型。
AI.motivation: 大规模视频生成模型被视为通向世界模型的有前景路径，但其能否捕捉因果一致的物理动态仍缺乏理解。现有评测多聚焦视觉质量、提示遵循度或宽泛的物理合理性，无法回答模型能否忠实实现完整因果级联（即初始事件经因果依赖的交互传播至终态结果）这一问题。
AI.method: 构建 CausalCascade：基于仿真器的基准，涵盖50个事件丰富的 Blender 场景，配以结构化事件图、基于事件图的诊断性 VQA、三级未来事件指定方式，以及2,832个受控反事实变体；并设计运动级、事件级、反事实级三类互补诊断指标，对九个图生视频模型进行评估。
AI.result: 生成的运动在空间定位上比在正确的时空演化上更可靠；更丰富的未来事件指定可提升事件召回，但物理实现仍受限；反事实评估显示模型对物理干预的选择性响应较弱；大多数审计到的失败是基础性的，出现在场景一致性或事件发生层面。
AI.conclusion: 因果级联生成应被视为世界建模的过程级测试。未来方法需同时满足四点：恢复预期未来、忠实实现其物理演化、对物理干预做出选择性响应、并在时间上维持一致的物理世界。代码与数据集已开源。

title: Genesis: Visual Augmentation Primitives for Multimodal Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models achieve promising results on visual reasoning tasks, approaching human-level performance on existing STEM benchmarks. However, these capabilities degrade under complex real-world scenes. We identify that chain-of-thought reasoning remains largely confined to the linguistic space, rarely anchoring each step in visual evidence. The main cause is the absence of such data during training. In this work, we introduce a training data augmentation pipeline, \textbf{Visual Augmentation Primitives} (VAP), which leverages state-of-the-art vision generative models to synthesize diverse photorealistic training samples and corresponding reasoning text. VAP introduces some basic operators and applies them to a seed image and gets a variant. It also constructs coherent multimodal reasoning chains throughout the generation process. Such training data force models to perceive visual content and perform logical reasoning according to them at every step. We further introduce multimodal chain-of-thought rubric-based reinforcement learning to enhance this. It rewards not only text reasoning but also visual reasoning by scoring intermediate reasoning steps for logical validity, completeness, and consistency. Moreover, we construct the UNREAL benchmark to systematically evaluate visual reasoning on hyperrealistic scenes across controllable difficulty levels. Experiments show that a 4B model built on this framework surpasses 8B baselines, with performance improving consistently as the model scales to 32B, validating the scaling law for visual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉增强原语(VAP)数据合成管线与多模态思维链评分奖励强化学习,并构建UNREAL基准,使模型在超写实场景中逐步基于视觉证据推理,4B模型超越8B基线且呈现规模效应。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在现有STEM基准上接近人类水平,但在复杂真实场景中性能显著退化。作者指出根因在于思维链推理仍局限于语言空间,各推理步骤很少锚定视觉证据,而这一问题的根源是训练数据中缺乏此类"视觉-文本"对齐的推理链数据。
AI.method: 提出训练数据增强管线VAP(视觉增强原语):利用先进视觉生成模型,对种子图像施加基本算子生成多样化的照片级真实变体,并在生成过程中同步构建连贯的多模态推理链,从而迫使模型在每一步都感知视觉内容并据此推理。在此基础上引入基于评分标准的多模态思维链强化学习,不仅对文本推理给予奖励,还对中间推理步骤的逻辑有效性、完整性与一致性进行视觉推理层面的评分。此外构建UNREAL基准,在可控难度等级下系统评估超写实场景中的视觉推理。
AI.result: 实验表明,基于该框架的4B模型性能超越8B基线模型;随着模型规模扩展至32B,性能持续提升,验证了视觉推理的规模定律(scaling law)。
AI.conclusion: 将推理步骤显式锚定于视觉证据,并通过数据合成与强化学习共同强化视觉推理,是提升多模态模型在复杂真实场景中推理能力的有效路径,且该能力具备良好的可扩展性。

title: Truncation Samplers Are Nested: Comparing Decoding Rules Is a Measurement Problem
summary: Settling one comparison between two truncation samplers has cost six thousand A100-hours, and nothing says in advance how far apart two samplers can be. We observe that almost every deployed truncation rule keeps a prefix of the probability-sorted vocabulary, so any two such rules are nested at every decoding step. Nesting yields a closed-form per-step distance and a coupling under which both samplers emit identical text until they first disagree. Accumulated over a generation, this gives a separation certificate that bounds the difference between two samplers on any bounded outcome, is computable from logs a comparison already produces, and equals their sequence-level total variation distance exactly when neither rule ever overtakes the other. Two consequences follow without measurement: exactness is fragile, and certifying a small difference requires the two retained masses to agree to very high precision at every step. On six open-weight models over four math and science benchmarks, the certificate for every hyperparameter grid we tested is at least 0.998, so a bound alone rarely settles a comparison, although two members of one family can be far closer. What remains useful is the coupling, which gives an unbiased paired estimator that cuts variance $1.2$-$3.8\times$ against prompt-level pairing. Read against benchmark sizes at the default pair's variance and our point estimate of its between-prompt component, resolving a one-point difference needs 8 to 32 samples per prompt on GSM8K, MATH-500 and GPQA-Diamond and about 210 on AIME 2025; at that component's upper confidence bound GPQA-Diamond needs more than 32 and AIME 2025 cannot be resolved at any sample count. Choosing a truncation sampler is a measurement problem at least as much as a design one. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/truncation-samplers.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究截断采样器（truncation samplers）比较的度量问题，提出基于嵌套性（nesting）的每步闭式距离与耦合方法，给出分离证书，并发现证书在绝大多数配置下接近1，因而比较困难；但耦合可提供无偏配对估计器，将方差降低1.2–3.8倍。
AI.motivation: 比较两个截断采样器的成本极高（单次比较需6000 A100小时），且事先无法判断两者差距，因此需要更高效、可计算的比较方法。
AI.method: 观察到几乎所有部署的截断规则都保留概率排序词表的前缀，因此任意两条规则在每步解码时都是嵌套的。基于嵌套性推导每步闭式距离，并构造一个耦合，使两个采样器在首次分歧前生成完全相同文本；累积得到分离证书，可界定两采样器在任意有界结果上的差异，并可从日志计算。当两条规则从不互相超越时，证书恰好等于序列级总变差距离。
AI.result: 在6个开源模型、4个数学与科学基准上，所测所有超参数网格的证书至少为0.998，说明仅靠界很难完成比较。耦合给出的无偏配对估计器相对prompt级配对将方差降低1.2–3.8倍。按默认配对的方差与点估计，在GSM8K、MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond上解决1分差异需每prompt 8–32个样本，AIME 2025约需210个；在置信上界下GPQA-Diamond需超过32个，而AIME 2025无法在任何样本数下解决。
AI.conclusion: 选择截断采样器不仅是设计问题，更是度量问题；分离证书往往过于宽松，而耦合带来的方差缩减才是实际可用的工具。

title: The Fragility and Dynamics of LLM Pruning-Recovery Steps
summary: Structural pruning followed by a recovery stage is the standard recipe for compressing large language models (LLMs), yet the two stages are typically designed and tuned in isolation. In this work, we study how their interaction shapes the compressed model, sweeping ordering, the data that drives each stage, and the alignment of their training objectives. We find that instruction-following is the first capability to collapse under pruning, well before knowledge, reasoning, or core language modeling, and that much of the pruning in-domain loss is likely not knowledge loss but a domain-agnostic failure to respond coherently to the prompt. We find in our setting that in-domain data is the strongest pruning signal, whereas instruction-style data recovers the most. Stage order matters little, but only marginally. We further analyze how the importance ranking drifts before and after pruning. Together these results give practitioners a concrete recipe for composing pruning and recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文研究结构化剪枝与恢复阶段的相互作用：指令跟随能力最先崩塌，域内数据是最强的剪枝信号，而指令风格数据最适合恢复；阶段顺序影响很小。
AI.motivation: 结构化剪枝加恢复是压缩大语言模型的标准范式，但两个阶段通常被孤立地设计和调优。作者希望理解二者的相互作用如何塑造压缩后的模型，从而为实践者提供组合剪枝与恢复的具体方案。
AI.method: 系统性扫描多个维度：两阶段的执行顺序、驱动各阶段的数据类型、以及两阶段训练目标的对齐方式；并分析剪枝前后重要性排序的漂移。
AI.result: 指令跟随能力在剪枝下最先崩塌，远早于知识、推理或核心语言建模能力；剪枝时的域内损失很大程度上并非知识损失，而是对提示做出连贯回应的领域无关性失效。域内数据是最强的剪枝信号，指令风格数据恢复效果最好。阶段顺序影响甚微。
AI.conclusion: 综合这些发现，为实践者提供了组合剪枝与恢复阶段的实用配方。

title: Towards Robust Calibration Dataset for Domain-General Mixture of Experts Pruning
summary: Post-training expert pruning is a promising deployment technique for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. The calibration set is an integral part of the pruning process, however, its correlation with evaluation performance is largely misunderstood and unintuitive. In this work, we present an empirical study of the robustness of calibration perturbations, specifically in MoE models. Showing how calibration size, language, and data distribution affect layer-wise expert pruning for gpt-oss-20b. Our findings reveal that (1) domain-general pruning quality receives minimal benefit from scaling calibration data beyond small sample sizes, (2) cross-lingual calibration transfers effectively, with English-only calibration maintaining strong performance across seven languages of varying typologies and scripts, and (3) a diverse calibration data resembling the pretraining distribution can yield comparable or superior performance to test-distribution data. Ultimately, we provide practical insights as a recipe for better understanding calibration for more effective domain-general expert pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文对MoE模型后训练专家剪枝中的校准集进行实证研究，揭示校准规模、语言与数据分布对gpt-oss-20b逐层专家剪枝的影响。
AI.motivation: 校准集是MoE专家剪枝的关键环节，但其与评测性能的相关性被普遍误解且不够直观，缺乏系统性的实证理解。
AI.method: 针对gpt-oss-20b开展校准扰动的鲁棒性实证研究，系统变化校准集大小、语言（如仅英语）与数据分布（预训练分布式多样数据 vs. 测试分布数据），观察其对逐层专家剪枝效果的影响。
AI.result: (1) 领域通用剪枝质量在超过小样本规模后，继续扩大校准数据收益甚微；(2) 跨语言校准迁移有效，仅用英语校准即可在七种语言（涵盖不同语系与文字）上保持强劲性能；(3) 接近预训练分布的多样化校准数据可取得与测试分布数据相当甚至更优的性能。
AI.conclusion: 研究提出了一套关于校准集的实用经验法则，为更有效地进行领域通用专家剪枝提供指导。

title: Ellipsoids from Tangents
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures. Written in 2016; posted in 2026 with revised exposition. Results unchanged
summary: This paper presents an algorithm for detecting and fitting multiple ellipsoids in 2D, 3D and higher-dimensional data. The representation is based on tangents to the ellipsoid together with their contact points, rather than on points alone. A tangent contributes d independent equations where a point contributes one, so each hypothesis needs fewer samples, which in turn reduces the number of iterations required to recover every ellipsoid. The problem is posed as sets of linear equations whose solutions -- the ellipsoid parameters -- are recovered robustly by clustering in parameter space. The algorithm works in all dimensions and outperforms the state of the art in 2D. The approach applies in general to the robust solution of linear equations, and so has utility beyond ellipsoid fitting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在2D、3D及更高维数据中检测并拟合多个椭球的算法。其核心是用椭球的切线与切点（而非仅用点）来表示椭球，每个切线贡献d个独立方程，从而减少每个假设所需样本数与迭代次数；问题被建模为线性方程组，并在参数空间中通过聚类稳健地恢复椭球参数，2D下性能优于现有方法，且方法可推广至一般线性方程组的稳健求解。
AI.motivation: 传统多点拟合椭球时，单个点仅提供一个方程，导致每个假设需要较多样本，进而使RANSAC类方法迭代次数多、效率低。作者希望借助更高效的几何表示来降低样本需求，并实现对多椭球、多维度场景的稳健拟合。
AI.method: 采用椭球切线与切点作为表示：一条切线贡献d个独立方程（点仅贡献1个），因此每个假设所需样本更少。将拟合问题转化为线性方程组求解，其解即椭球参数；随后在参数空间中进行聚类，以稳健地恢复各个椭球的参数。该方法适用于任意维度。
AI.result: 算法可在2D、3D及更高维数据中检测并拟合多个椭球；由于切线带来更多独立方程，所需样本数与迭代次数均减少；在2D情形下性能优于当前最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于切线的表示能有效降低假设样本需求并提升多椭球拟合的稳健性与效率；该思路具有通用性，可推广到一般线性方程组的稳健求解问题，应用价值超出椭球拟合本身。

title: The Gradient That Top-k Distillation Never Computes
summary: Many deployed distillation pipelines show the student a truncated view of the teacher: keep the top-k probabilities, renormalize, and minimize a divergence on what remains. Renormalization is assumed to account for the missing mass. We prove that it removes the visibility of tail mass, not the freedom to move it. The renormalized objective depends only on log-odds among the retained tokens, so at each position its gradient along the directions that control tail mass is exactly zero; on a real teacher that component measures $2$-$3\times10^{-15}$ of the gradient. The full-vocabulary gradient equals the truncated gradient plus a residual weighted by the tail masses, and training acts only on the first term. Without the cross-entropy term, a top-k student's tail mass drifts away from the teacher's while a full-vocabulary control moves slightly toward it; with it, the gap shrinks about fourfold but persists. On seven open-weight teachers, the retained set determines the teacher's distribution only from $k=d+1$ ($d$ the hidden dimension): recovery is exact from there on all seven, and commonly cached sizes sit below it. In our off-policy runs the practical effect is real but smaller than the choice of teacher-student pair. Renormalization is a normalization, not a safeguard. The code is available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/top-k-distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明 top-k 蒸馏中的重归一化只是归一化操作，并非对尾部概率质量的保护：它使目标函数对尾部质量的梯度恒为零，导致学生模型的尾部质量自由漂移，且常用缓存规模低于精确恢复教师分布所需的最小 k 值。
AI.motivation: 部署中的蒸馏流程通常只让学生看到教师的截断视图（保留 top-k 概率并重归一化），并假设重归一化能补偿缺失的质量。作者希望检验这一假设是否成立，即重归一化是否真的约束了尾部概率质量的行为。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明重归一化目标仅依赖保留 token 之间的对数几率（log-odds），因而其沿控制尾部质量方向的梯度严格为零；推导全词表梯度等于截断梯度加上由尾部质量加权的残差。实证验证：测量真实教师上该梯度分量的大小，进行有无交叉熵项的训练对照实验（top-k 学生与全词表对照），并在七个开放权重教师上测试从何 k 值起保留集合能唯一决定教师分布。
AI.result: 重归一化目标沿尾部质量方向的梯度在真实教师上仅为 2–3×10^-15 量级；训练仅作用于梯度第一项。无交叉熵项时，top-k 学生的尾部质量远离教师，而全词表对照略微靠近；加入交叉熵项后差距缩小约四倍但仍存在。在七个开放权重教师上，当 k=d+1（d 为隐藏维）时保留集合即可精确恢复教师分布，而常用缓存规模通常低于该阈值。离策略实验中实际影响真实存在，但小于师生配对选择带来的影响。
AI.conclusion: 重归一化是归一化而非安全机制：它消除了尾部质量的可见性，却未限制其可移动的自由度。因此 top-k 蒸馏会在保留集之外产生持续的尾部质量偏差，实用中应关注 k 与交叉熵项的选择及师生配对。

title: FireNav: Decision-Oriented Reconstruction Evidence Routing for Vision-Language Navigation in Indoor Fire Environments
summary: In real-world indoor fire environments, visual degradation severely impairs instruction grounding, waypoint prediction, and long-horizon exploration in vision-language navigation (VLN). Although image restoration offers a natural means to mitigate such visual degradation, existing methods primarily optimize reconstruction fidelity, which does not necessarily translate into better navigation decisions and may even corrupt task-critical cues when applied indiscriminately. In this paper, we present FireNav, a decision-oriented reconstruction evidence routing framework that aligns visual restoration with navigation utility in VLN. To advance this task, we first contribute FireVLN-Bench, a paired indoor fire navigation benchmark with clean references preserving task semantics, safety supervision, and matched settings for continuous navigation and robot execution with simulated dynamics. Our FireNav retains native visual tokens and treats latent reconstruction features as auxiliary evidence, where a lightweight router leverages visual features, task context, and prior execution states to determine whether such evidence should be admitted and how strongly it should contribute to the visual tokens. To learn when reconstruction is beneficial, we further introduce decision utility calibration, which compares action prediction losses with and without candidate evidence under the same state, thereby supervising evidence selection according to its contribution to waypoint, heading, and arrival prediction. Experiments demonstrate that FireNav consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in both navigation success and path efficiency across evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出FireNav，一种面向决策的重建证据路由框架，将图像修复与视觉语言导航效用对齐，并贡献了FireVLN-Bench室内火灾导航基准，在导航成功率与路径效率上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 室内火灾环境中视觉退化严重影响视觉语言导航（VLN）的指令接地、路点预测与长程探索。现有图像修复方法主要优化重建保真度，未必能转化为更好的导航决策，甚至可能因不加区分地应用而破坏任务关键线索。
AI.method: 提出FireNav决策导向的重建证据路由框架：保留原生视觉token，将潜在重建特征作为辅助证据；由轻量路由器基于视觉特征、任务上下文和先验执行状态，决定是否接纳该证据及其对视觉token的贡献强度。同时引入决策效用校准，在同一状态下比较有无候选证据时的动作预测损失，依据其对路点、朝向与到达预测的贡献来监督证据选择。此外构建FireVLN-Bench配对基准，含保留任务语义的清晰参考、安全监督，并以模拟动力学匹配连续导航与机器人执行设置。
AI.result: 实验表明，FireNav在多种评估设置下的导航成功率与路径效率均持续优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉重建与导航效用对齐、按决策贡献自适应地路由重建证据，可有效缓解火灾等退化视觉环境下的VLN性能下降；所提出的FireVLN-Bench为相关研究提供了配对、语义一致的评测平台。

title: Squeeze-Aware-YOLO: Early Channel Recalibration and Multi-Scale Fusion for Real-Time Traffic Sign Detection
comment: Accepted at DICTA 2026 (International Conference on Digital Image Computing: Techniques and Applications, Sydney, Australia). 8 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables
summary: Traffic sign detection plays a vital role in intelligent transportation systems, supporting the safe operation of advanced driver assistance systems and autonomous vehicles. Despite significant progress in real-time object detection, accurately identifying traffic signs under challenging conditions remains difficult. Variations in lighting, adverse weather, motion blur, and partial occlusion often reduce detection performance, especially for small or visually degraded signs where important spatial information can be lost. To address these challenges, we propose Squeeze-Aware-YOLO, a lightweight traffic sign detection framework that introduces a multi-branch bottleneck module combining convolutional kernels of different sizes with a Squeeze-and-Excitation mechanism to improve feature extraction and adaptive channel weighting. In addition, we integrate the Multi-Branch Auxiliary Feature Pyramid Network and Re-parameterized Heterogeneous Multi-Scale modules to strengthen multi-scale feature representation and feature fusion while preserving real-time inference efficiency for practical deployment. The proposed approach is evaluated on the Bangladeshi Traffic Sign Detection Dataset, the CSUST Chinese Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark 2021, and the German Traffic Sign Detection Benchmark, achieving mAP@0.5 scores of 74.7%, 79.4%, and 84.0%, respectively, while consistently outperforming recent state-of-the-art YOLO-based traffic sign detectors. These findings demonstrate that combining multi-scale receptive fields, channel attention, and enhanced feature fusion enables more accurate and robust traffic sign detection while maintaining the computational efficiency required for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级交通标志检测框架Squeeze-Aware-YOLO，通过多分支瓶颈模块结合SE机制、多分支辅助特征金字塔与重参数化异构多尺度模块，在三个数据集上取得74.7%、79.4%、84.0%的mAP@0.5，兼顾精度与实时性。
AI.motivation: 交通标志检测对智能交通系统、高级驾驶辅助系统与自动驾驶的安全运行至关重要。尽管实时目标检测已有显著进展，但在光照变化、恶劣天气、运动模糊和部分遮挡等复杂条件下，尤其是小尺寸或视觉退化的标志，空间信息易丢失，检测性能明显下降，因此需要提升复杂场景下的检测精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出Squeeze-Aware-YOLO轻量级框架：1）多分支瓶颈模块，融合不同尺寸卷积核与Squeeze-and-Excitation机制，增强特征提取并进行自适应通道加权；2）引入多分支辅助特征金字塔网络（Multi-Branch Auxiliary FPN）与重参数化异构多尺度模块，强化多尺度特征表达与特征融合，同时保持实时推理效率以利于实际部署。
AI.result: 在孟加拉国交通标志检测数据集、CSUST中国交通标志检测基准2021和德国交通标志检测基准上评估，mAP@0.5分别达到74.7%、79.4%和84.0%，持续优于近期基于YOLO的先进交通标志检测器。
AI.conclusion: 结合多尺度感受野、通道注意力与增强特征融合，可在保持实际部署所需计算效率的同时，实现更准确、更鲁棒的交通标志检测。

title: Lesion-Aware Attention for Mammography Segmentation with Heterogeneous Supervision
summary: Accurate lesion segmentation in mammography is important for computer-aided breast cancer diagnosis, but dense pixel-level annotations remain costly and limited. Existing public segmentation datasets usually cover only a small set of lesion types with manually delineated masks, whereas larger mammography datasets often provide only image-level diagnostic labels. This annotation mismatch makes it difficult to train segmentation models that can generalize to rare or weakly annotated lesion categories. To address this problem, we study open-vocabulary mammographic lesion segmentation under a mixed-supervision setting, where pixel-level masks are available for base lesion categories and image-level labels are available for a broader set of categories. We propose a two-branch framework that jointly learns from segmentation data and classification data. The segmentation branch learns lesion boundaries from annotated masks, while the classification branch introduces additional image-level semantic supervision. To better transfer image-level supervision to lesion-relevant regions, we further introduce a Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier that maintains category-specific feature prototypes and generates lesion-aware attention maps for foreground feature pooling. This design reduces the influence of background tissue and encourages more compact lesion representations. Experiments on multiple mammography datasets show that the proposed method consistently improves open-vocabulary segmentation baselines on both base and novel lesion categories, while reducing the gap to fully supervised models that require dense target-domain masks. Qualitative results further indicate that our method produces more complete lesion localization for small, low-contrast, and visually subtle mammographic findings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究混合监督下的开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割，提出双分支框架结合分割掩码与图像级标签监督，并设计病灶感知注意力分类器，在多个数据集上优于开放词汇基线。
AI.motivation: 乳腺X线精确病灶分割对计算机辅助乳腺癌诊断重要，但像素级标注昂贵且稀缺。现有公开分割数据集仅覆盖少量病灶类型且带手工掩码，而更大型数据集往往只提供图像级诊断标签，这种标注不匹配导致难以训练能泛化到稀有或弱标注病灶类别的分割模型。
AI.method: 提出双分支框架，同时从分割数据和分类数据学习：分割分支从标注掩码学习病灶边界，分类分支引入额外图像级语义监督。为进一步将图像级监督迁移到病灶相关区域，引入病灶感知注意力分类器（Lesion-wise Attentive Classifier），维护类别特定特征原型并生成病灶感知注意力图用于前景特征池化，以减少背景组织影响并促使更紧凑的病灶表示。
AI.result: 在多个乳腺X线数据集上的实验表明，该方法在基础和新颖病灶类别上均持续优于开放词汇分割基线，同时缩小了与需要密集目标域掩码的全监督模型的差距。定性结果显示，该方法对小尺寸、低对比度和视觉上不明显的乳腺病灶能产生更完整的定位。
AI.conclusion: 混合监督结合图像级语义监督与病灶感知注意力池化，可有效提升开放词汇乳腺X线病灶分割的泛化能力，缓解像素级标注稀缺问题。

title: 1Step-WAM: Your World Action Model but Faster using 1-Step Action Generation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) unify visual world modeling and action generation, yet their real-world deployment is heavily bottlenecked by iterative action denoising and the sequential execution of visual prefilling and action prediction. We demonstrate that the action-denoising trajectories in WAMs are approximately straight, rendering the first-step velocity a strong estimate of the final action direction. Building on this observation, we introduce 1Step-WAM, a framework that transforms multi-step action denoising into one single forward. Specifically, we employ a lightweight calibrator to directly correct the first step velocity, and use bandwidth-constrained action decoding to further reduce errors in the calibrated one-step actions. Compressing action generation into a single step enables it to execute in parallel with visual prefilling, completely breaking the sequential bottleneck of the traditional imagination-then-action paradigm. Evaluations on RoboTwin and LIBERO show that 1Step-WAM largely preserves multi-step task success with only about 13.4M trainable parameters, while achieving inference speedups of $7.44\times$, $5.98\times$, and $24.84\times$ for FastWAM, ImageWAM and Kairos, respectively. Furthermore, real-world robotic deployments using the FastWAM backbone confirm a consistent 7.44$\times$ speedup while maintaining close success rate to the multi-step baseline. Code is avaliable at https://github.com/changdong1687/1Step-WAM.

AI.tldr: 1Step-WAM将World Action Models的多步动作去噪压缩为单步前向，通过校正首步速度并并行化视觉预填充与动作预测，实现显著推理加速。
AI.motivation: WAMs统一了视觉世界建模与动作生成，但迭代式动作去噪以及视觉预填充与动作预测的顺序执行，严重制约了其真实部署效率。
AI.method: 观察到动作去噪轨迹近似为直线，首步速度可作为最终动作方向的强估计。据此引入轻量校准器直接校正首步速度，并采用带宽受限的动作解码进一步降低单步动作误差；将动作生成压缩为单步后可与视觉预填充并行执行，打破"先想象后动作"的顺序瓶颈。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin和LIBERO上，1Step-WAM仅用约13.4M可训练参数便基本保持多步任务成功率，对FastWAM、ImageWAM、Kairos分别取得7.44×、5.98×、24.84×的推理加速。基于FastWAM主干的真实机器人部署验证了一致的7.44×加速并保持接近多步基线的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 多步动作去噪轨迹近似直线，使得单步生成结合速度校准与并行执行成为可行方案，在保持任务成功率的同时大幅提升WAMs推理效率。

title: Robust Detection of Directional Adversarial Attacks in Deep Neural Networks for Radiological Imaging
comment: Published in CVPR 2026 Workshops (SAIAD); open access: https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content/CVPR2026W/SAIAD/html/Malatynski_Robust_Detection_of_Directional_Adversarial_Attacks_in_Deep_Neural_Networks_CVPRW_2026_paper.html
summary: Deep learning is now central to radiology, helping detect changes on X-rays, CTs, and MRIs. However, these systems are highly vulnerable to adversarial attacks - small, crafted perturbations that mislead models while appearing unchanged to humans. Such errors risk missed cancers or false positives. Studies show over 90% attack success on medical scans. Almost 30% of US hospitals use AI in imaging in 2023. Thus, an effective method of detecting such attacks and their directionality is crucial to ensure the credibility and reliability of medical systems based on DNNs. We propose a novel detection framework that leverages subsequent attacks using random noise to identify adversarial perturbations. Our approach uses the analysis of variations in the Sigmoid function to distinguish genuine medical images from adversarially manipulated ones. Specifically, we compare prediction differences between clean and attacked images, as well as between different adversarially altered versions, to improve detection accuracy. We evaluated our method on three popular medical datasets including 'Chest X-Ray Images for Classification', 'Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset' and 'Brain Tumor Dataset' under various attack scenarios, including random noise. Our framework achieved up to 99.8% ACC in identifying adversarial directional attacks, significantly outperforming existing defense mechanisms. It consistently identified adversarial samples across varying attack strengths while keeping false positives low, showing strong reliability and potential for clinical use. Furthermore, our proposal highlights its potential for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于随机噪声后续攻击与Sigmoid函数变化分析的对抗样本检测框架，在三个医学影像数据集上实现最高99.8%的检测准确率。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在放射学（X光、CT、MRI）中广泛应用，但对抗攻击成功率超过90%，可能导致癌症漏诊或假阳性；2023年美国近30%医院在影像中使用AI，因此检测对抗扰动及其方向性对DNN医学系统的可信度至关重要。
AI.method: 利用随机噪声实施后续攻击以识别对抗扰动；通过分析Sigmoid函数的变化来区分真实医学图像与对抗样本；具体比较干净图像与受攻击图像之间、以及不同对抗版本之间的预测差异以提升检测精度。
AI.result: 在'Chest X-Ray Images for Classification'、'Retinal Fundus Multi-disease Image Dataset'和'Brain Tumor Dataset'三个数据集及多种攻击场景（含随机噪声）下评估，识别对抗方向性攻击的准确率最高达99.8%，显著优于现有防御机制；在不同攻击强度下稳定识别对抗样本并保持低假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架具有强可靠性与临床应用潜力，并展现出实际部署的前景。

title: SurgCast: Action-Conditioned Future Skeletons for Controllable Surgical World Models
summary: Surgical world models must turn prospective robot actions into visually faithful, structurally consistent instrument motion. We introduce SurgCast, which predicts future instrument skeletons from current structure, robot state, and future actions, then uses the forecast to control video generation. Dual-path injection combines skeleton geometry with derived, instrument-specific motion descriptors through geometric residuals and conditioning modulation. Both paths complement native action conditioning and are retained in a four-step causal student. On SutureBot and SRTH-Porcine-Cholei, the teacher and student improve all seven reported quality and instrument-consistency metrics over their respective direct-action baselines; teacher FVD decreases by 37.6% and 67.3%. Ablations show that future actions improve skeleton prediction and that combining both injection paths performs best across all six metrics under predicted skeletons. These results support using predicted articulated structure and its motion semantics as a control interface for surgical video prediction. Project videos and examples are available at https://surgcast.netlify.app/.

AI.tldr: SurgCast通过预测未来器械骨架并以其控制手术视频生成，显著提升视频保真度与器械一致性。
AI.motivation: 手术世界模型需将机器人动作转化为视觉真实且结构一致的器械运动，现有直接动作条件方法难以保证器械结构一致性。
AI.method: 方法先由当前结构、机器人状态和未来动作预测未来器械骨架，再用该预测控制视频生成；采用双路径注入，将骨架几何与器械专用运动描述子通过几何残差和条件调制融合，并与原生动作条件共同保留在四步因果学生模型中。
AI.result: 在SutureBot与SRTH-Porcine-Cholei上，教师与学生模型在全部七项质量与器械一致性指标上均优于各自直接动作基线，教师FVD分别降低37.6%和67.3%；消融显示未来动作提升骨架预测，且在预测骨架下双路径组合在六项指标上最优。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可将预测的关节结构与运动语义作为手术视频预测的控制接口。

title: Sparse All-Layer Connector for Domain Generalised Semantic Segmentation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. The final version will be updated soon
summary: Domain generalised semantic segmentation (DGSS) has recently benefited from combining multiple foundation models, such as vision-language and vision foundation models, to leverage their diverse representations for generalisation. Existing multi-model approaches share a common design choice: cross-model fusion is restricted to depth-aligned layers, implicitly assuming that mutually beneficial information resides at the same depth across models. However, foundation models pretrained under different objectives may develop distinct representation hierarchies, making the optimality of depth-aligned fusion questionable. Moreover, we observe that the foundation models exhibit different depth-wise domain sensitivity. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Sparse All-Layer Connector (SALC) that enables each layer to access information from preceding layers of another model. As the number of accessible layers grows with depth, dense aggregation may hurt generalisation. SALC therefore learns to adaptively select a sparse subset of informative layers. We further introduce a candidate dropout regularisation that strengthens sparsity and encourages SALC to explore diverse layers, leading to more robust selection. Across four foundation model combinations and three DGSS evaluation settings, the proposed design demonstrates stronger generalisation than conventional depth-aligned fusion. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/SALC.

AI.tldr: 提出SALC（稀疏全层连接器），突破跨模型融合仅在深度对齐层进行的限制，实现任意前层信息访问并稀疏选择信息层，在四个基础模型组合与三个DGSS设定上优于深度对齐融合。
AI.motivation: 现有多基础模型DGSS方法普遍采用"深度对齐"融合假设，即认为互益信息位于不同模型的相同深度。但不同预训练目标的基础模型会形成不同的表征层级，且深度方向上的域敏感性各异，因此深度对齐融合的最优性存疑。
AI.method: SALC允许每一层访问另一模型所有前层的信息；由于可访问层数随深度增加，采用可学习机制自适应地选择稀疏的信息层子集，避免密集聚合损害泛化；并引入候选层dropout正则化以增强稀疏性、促进探索多样层，从而获得更稳健的选择。
AI.result: 在四种基础模型组合与三种DGSS评测设定下，所提设计的泛化性能均强于传统深度对齐融合。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型融合不应受限于深度对齐，全层稀疏连接配合自适应选择与dropout正则化能更充分挖掘多基础模型的互补表征，提升域泛化语义分割性能。

title: Feedback as an Interface: Controlling Form and Detail in LLM Translation Refinement
summary: Feedback presentation shapes how LLMs use evaluator judgments during translation refinement. We introduce a machine translation protocol that keeps the evaluator score, main issue, and recommendation fixed while varying feedback form and supporting detail. Across seven models and six translation directions, low-load feedback outperforms high-load feedback in all 42 translator-direction settings under xCOMET. On the 29,400-record rewriting subset, mean xCOMET scores multiplied by 100 are 83.30 for low-load feedback and 80.67 for high-load feedback; the full-matrix original-translation reference mean is 83.46. MetricX-24 supports the low-load advantage on a stratified subset. A no-feedback second pass yields a small improvement over the original translations, and direct evaluator prompting reproduces the low-load advantage without a separate rewriting stage. These results show that compact feedback limits the quality loss from evaluator-guided refinement in the evaluated high-resource MT settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究反馈呈现形式如何影响LLM在翻译精修中利用评估者判断。在固定评估分数、主要问题与建议的前提下,仅改变反馈形式与支撑细节,发现低负载反馈优于高负载反馈。
AI.motivation: 评估者引导的翻译精修中,反馈内容的呈现方式可能影响LLM对判断的利用效果,但此前缺乏对反馈形式(而非反馈内容)的系统性控制实验。
AI.method: 提出一种机器翻译协议:保持评估者分数、主要问题与建议不变,仅变化反馈形式与支撑细节。在7个模型、6个翻译方向上对比低负载反馈与高负载反馈,并以xCOMET评估;在含29,400条记录的重写子集上统计均值,再用MetricX-24在分层子集上验证,并设置无反馈二次改写与直接评估者提示两组对照。
AI.result: 42个“翻译器–方向”组合下低负载反馈全部优于高负载反馈;重写子集上xCOMET(×100)均值为低负载83.30、高负载80.67,而全矩阵原始翻译参考均值为83.46;MetricX-24支持低负载优势;无反馈二次改写相对原始翻译有小幅提升;直接评估者提示可复现低负载优势且无需独立重写阶段。
AI.conclusion: 在所评估的高资源机器翻译场景中,紧凑反馈能限制评估者引导精修带来的质量损失。

title: A Persian Vision-Language-Action Dataset and Benchmark for Ambiguity- and Infeasibility-Aware Instruction-to-Plan Grounding
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Preprint submitted to Language Resources and Evaluation
summary: Converting natural-language instructions into executable action plans conditioned on a scene image is a core capability for embodied human-robot interaction, but existing benchmarks target English, simulated or video-grounded environments, and largely assume instructions are clear and executable. We introduce the first Persian vision-language-action dataset for this task: 258 instances over 230 real household/office photographs, annotated with reference plans, deliberate ambiguity and infeasibility labels, disambiguating question-answer pairs, and an auto-generated chain-of-thought rationale for training. Using this resource, we ablate retrieval-augmentation, chain-of-thought prompting, and an agentic disambiguation step, evaluated with an LLM-as-judge protocol and a new metric, PGOS-FA, extending prior work (PG2S) with step-order sensitivity, an over-generation penalty, and Persian-adapted embeddings. Paired statistical testing across 36 comparisons shows retrieval-augmentation is a large, robustly significant effect, while finer-grained additions are directionally consistent but not statistically distinguishable from noise at this scale, and the LLM-judge metric has near-zero power where PGOS-FA succeeds. A blind human-correlation study on 79 real outputs shows PGOS-FA tracks human judgment at least as closely as the LLM-judge. Testing generalization beyond the ablation's single backbone, we find that most of the gap between an open-weight and a substantially stronger closed planner is attributable to open-weight model generation rather than to the closed model's capability specifically, and that our best configuration significantly outperforms an independently reproduced external baseline despite a weaker backbone. The dataset, PGOS-FA implementation, and evaluation code will be made available upon reasonable request.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了首个波斯语视觉-语言-动作数据集（258个实例、230张真实照片），并系统评估了检索增强、思维链提示与智能体消歧步骤，提出新指标PGOS-FA。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多面向英语、仿真或视频环境，且假设指令清晰可执行，缺乏波斯语真实场景下的视觉-语言-动作（具身人机交互）数据集与评估方法。
AI.method: 构建波斯语视觉-语言-动作数据集，含参考计划、歧义与不可行标签、消歧问答对及自动生成的思维链理由；对检索增强、思维链提示、智能体消歧进行消融；采用LLM-as-judge协议与PGOS-FA指标（在PG2S基础上加入步骤顺序敏感度、过度生成惩罚、波斯语适配嵌入）评估，并做36组配对统计检验与79个真实输出的盲测人类相关性研究。
AI.result: 检索增强效果显著且稳健；更细粒度增强方向一致但未达统计显著；LLM-judge指标在PGOS-FA有效处几乎无检验力；PGOS-FA与人类判断的相关性至少不逊于LLM-judge；开权重与闭源规划器的差距主要源于生成能力而非闭源模型特有能力，最佳配置显著优于独立复现的外部基线（尽管骨干较弱）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了首个波斯语视觉-语言-动作基准与更可靠的评估指标PGOS-FA，揭示检索增强的关键作用及LLM-judge的局限，但受数据规模限制更细粒度增强效果尚不显著；数据集、指标实现与评估代码将按合理请求开放。

title: Rate-Resolved Text Evaluation with Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: A single evaluation score can rank generation systems but rarely reveals what failed. We propose rate-resolved text evaluation, which turns the masking rate of masked diffusion language models into a diagnostic axis. By reconstructing text under different fractions of masked tokens, one diffusion score becomes a vector of band-conditioned scores that reflect reconstruction difficulty at varying levels of visible context. On SummEval, preserving this rate structure yields complementary signal: the best masking-rate band improves fusion with autoregressive likelihood over a collapsed diffusion scalar, survives a sample-shuffle control that breaks rate ordering, and adds residual signal to a fixed prompted judge. A second diffusion model reproduces the effect more weakly. On WMT MQM zh-en, roundtrip mask-and-reconstruct probing produces a tunable localization curve in which ranking-oriented AUROC and span-detection F1 peak at different masking rates. Factuality benchmarks bound the interpretation: band semantics are model- and task-dependent, so each application requires empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"速率分辨文本评价"(rate-resolved text evaluation)，将掩码扩散语言模型的掩码率作为诊断轴，通过在不同掩码比例下重建文本，把单一扩散分数扩展为带条件的分数向量，以揭示生成系统在不同可见上下文水平下的重建难度。
AI.motivation: 单一评价分数虽能对生成系统排序，却几乎无法揭示"是什么失败了"。作者希望获得一种既能保留排序能力、又能提供细粒度诊断信息的评价方法。
AI.method: 将掩码扩散语言模型的掩码率转化为诊断维度：在不同掩码比例下进行重建，得到带条件的分数向量；在SummEval上进行融合实验、样本打乱对照与固定提示评判器的残差检验；在WMT MQM zh-en上使用往返掩码-重建探测；并用事实性基准进行边界验证。
AI.result: 在SummEval上，保留速率结构带来互补信号：最佳掩码率带在与自回归似然融合时优于坍缩后的扩散标量，能经受破坏速率顺序的样本打乱对照，并为固定提示评判器提供残差信号；第二个扩散模型复现了该效应但更弱。在WMT MQM zh-en上，往返探测产生可调定位曲线，AUROC与跨度检测F1在不同掩码率处达到峰值。
AI.conclusion: 带语义依赖于模型与任务，因此每项应用都需经验验证；事实性基准为这一解释设定了边界。

title: ProtoPur: Prototype-Purity Pseudo-Labeling for Weakly Supervised Instance Learning in Pathology
summary: Weak bag-level labels are widely available in computational pathology, whereas reliable instance-level annotations for whole-slide images remain expensive and ambiguous. Weakly supervised multiple instance learning (MIL) achieves strong bag-level classification, but instance-level supervision from attention scores, model predictions, negative bags, or spatial refinement may fail to identify class-specific local evidence. We propose ProtoPur, a prototype-purity pseudo-labeling method for weakly supervised instance-level learning in pathology whole-slide images. ProtoPur estimates class-balanced local purity over prototype regions constructed from frozen foundation-model features, and assigns pseudo-labels to high-purity regions strongly associated with a target class. This purity-first design separates class-specific evidence from negative or shared morphology, with coverage used only to ensure sufficient pseudo-label assignment. We provide a PAC-style analysis showing that the risk of an instance classifier trained with ProtoPur pseudo-labels can be decomposed into a standard uniform-convergence term and a ProtoPur-specific pseudo-label noise term, comprising selected-region mismatch and a coverage residual. Experiments on three public whole-slide image datasets with two pathology foundation encoders show that ProtoPur consistently improves instance-level performance across multiple MIL backbones while maintaining competitive bag-level performance. Pseudo-label quality comparisons on two public datasets further demonstrate that prototype-purity selection provides stronger instance supervision. These results suggest that the foundation-model features contain exploitable instance-level supervision signals, and ProtoPur is a way to reveal and use these signals from weak bag labels without requiring dense instance annotations.

AI.tldr: ProtoPur是一种基于原型纯度的伪标签方法，用于病理全切片图像中的弱监督实例级学习。
AI.motivation: 全切片图像的弱包级标签易获取，但可靠的实例级标注昂贵且模糊。现有弱监督MIL虽在包级分类表现优异，但基于注意力分数、模型预测、负包或空间细化的实例级监督往往无法识别类特定的局部证据。
AI.method: ProtoPur在由冻结基础模型特征构建的原型区域上估计类平衡的局部纯度，并为与目标类别强相关的高纯度区域分配伪标签。该"纯度优先"设计将类特定证据与负性或共享形态分离，覆盖率仅用于保证足够的伪标签分配。作者提供PAC风格分析，将风险分解为均匀收敛项与ProtoPur特有的伪标签噪声项（含所选区域失配与覆盖残差）。
AI.result: 在三个公共全切片数据集与两种病理基础编码器上，ProtoPur在多种MIL骨干上持续提升实例级性能，同时保持有竞争力的包级性能。在两个公共数据集上的伪标签质量比较进一步表明，原型纯度选择提供更强的实例监督。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型特征蕴含可挖掘的实例级监督信号，ProtoPur能够从弱包标签中揭示并利用这些信号，无需密集实例标注。

title: Recovering Low-Bit Failures in Vision-Language-Action Policies via Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Quantization lowers deployment costs of vision-language-action (VLA) policies but can compromise task completion. Across five VLA models and 4,050 real-world trials, we systematically reveal that quantization-aware training (QAT) generally improves on post-training quantization (PTQ) but leaves substantial gaps to full precision (FP) on long-horizon tasks and under visual and semantic shifts, while its imitation-based objective does not explicitly use rollout success or partial completion. To exploit these outcome signals, we introduce Quantization-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning (QCRL), an offline RL method coupling progress-based advantage estimation with quantization-aware source conditioning. FP rollouts supply reference experience beyond action-level distillation, progress-scaled terminal penalty distinguishes partial completion, and quantization-aware conditioning selects advantageous reference behavior within the quantized policy. We evaluate weight-only INT4 W4A16 on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 and joint weight-activation NVFP4 W4A4 on $π_{0.5}$. Using only in-distribution data, QCRL reaches 99.3% of FP's mean score across three visual-shift conditions for $π_{0.5}$ with INT4 W4A16, alongside 42.9% model-memory savings. With NVFP4 W4A4, it reaches 100.7% of the same FP baseline, alongside a $1.73\times$ speedup using NVFP4/FP8 deployment. Hardware gains are relative to FP16 on Jetson Thor.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评测了VLA策略量化后的任务完成退化，并提出量化条件强化学习（QCRL）以利用rollout结果信号弥补量化损失，在INT4/NVFP4设定下几乎追平FP基线。
AI.motivation: 量化可降低视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的部署成本，但会损害任务完成度。作者通过5个VLA模型、4,050次真实世界试验发现：QAT通常优于PTQ，但在长时程任务以及视觉、语义分布偏移下仍与全精度（FP）存在明显差距，其根源在于模仿学习目标未显式利用rollout成功与否及部分完成等结果信号。
AI.method: 提出量化条件强化学习（QCRL），一种离线RL方法，耦合基于进度的优势估计与量化感知源条件。具体包括：(1) 用FP rollout提供超越动作级蒸馏的参考经验；(2) 使用进度缩放的终端惩罚区分部分完成任务；(3) 量化感知条件在量化策略内部选取有利的参考行为。评测设置：π0.5与GR00T N1.5上的权重-only INT4 W4A16，以及π0.5上的权重-激活联合NVFP4 W4A4。
AI.result: 仅使用分布内数据，π0.5在INT4 W4A16下于三种视觉偏移条件下达到FP平均得分的99.3%，同时节省42.9%模型显存；在NVFP4 W4A4下达到同一FP基线的100.7%，并使用NVFP4/FP8部署获得1.73倍加速。硬件收益相对于Jetson Thor上的FP16。
AI.conclusion: 结果信号（rollout成功与部分完成）可被离线RL有效利用，从而在极低比特量化下几乎无损甚至超越FP基线，兼顾精度与显存、推理速度的部署收益。

title: The Mathematical Collective Unconscious: Jungian Archetypes within the Latent Space
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 22 tables. Investigating Jungian archetypes in transformer latent spaces across synthetic baselines, Shmoop literature, DreamBank dreams, and Andrew Lang folklore corpora
summary: Carl Jung theorised that the human psyche contains an inherited framework, the collective unconscious, populated by universal archetypes. As large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast corpora of textual data, this paper investigates whether they spontaneously construct distinct archetype-like regions within their high-dimensional latent spaces. The paper proposes that these regions function as spatial constraints that naturally organise semantically related narratives. To evaluate this, we applied cosine similarity and angular distance metrics across thirteen experiments utilising OpenAIs text-embedding-3-small model. The paper contains two experimental sections the first section explores these ideas using synthetically constructed narratives, the results of which act as a baselines for experiments conducted in the second section where the synthetic data is replaced by human-authored literature (Shmoop corpus), unedited dream reports (DreamBank corpus), and culturally distilled folklore (Andrew Langs Fairy Books). The results show that archetypal roles occupy distinct, measurable regions in the latent space. Crucially, these regions remain compact and consistent because of narrative structure rather than simple word overlap. Additionally, text category dictates spatial distribution: dream reports concentrate within Trickster and Shadow regions, while traditional folklore distributes evenly across all tested archetypes. We conclude that transformer latent spaces encode stable regions which appear to correspond to recognised Jungian archetypes.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究大语言模型（LLM）的高维潜空间中是否自发形成荣格原型般的区域，并通过13组余弦相似度与角距离实验加以验证。
AI.motivation: 基于荣格"集体无意识"与"原型"理论：既然LLM在庞大文本语料上训练，其潜空间可能自发涌现出类似原型的结构性区域，从而以空间约束方式组织语义相关的叙事。
AI.method: 使用OpenAI text-embedding-3-small模型，设计13组实验，采用余弦相似度与角距离度量。实验分两部分：第一部分以合成叙事构建基线；第二部分改用人类创作文本，包括Shmoop语料（人工文学作品）、DreamBank语料（未编辑梦境报告）与Andrew Lang童话集（文化提炼的民间传说）。
AI.result: 原型角色在潜空间中占据可区分、可测量的区域；这些区域因叙事结构而非单纯词汇重叠而保持紧凑与一致。文本类别决定空间分布：梦境报告集中于Trickster与Shadow区域，传统民间传说则均匀分布于所有受测原型。
AI.conclusion: Transformer潜空间编码了稳定的区域，这些区域似乎对应公认的荣格原型。

title: Rethinking Human Intent-to-CAD: Parametric CAD Model Generation via Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. Published in Proceedings of Machine Learning Research (PMLR), Volume 306
summary: Parametric Computer-Aided-Design (CAD) modeling from human intent remains challenging, particularly during the conceptual design stage, where design goals are expressed through incomplete and unstructured modalities (e.g., hand-drawn sketches and textual descriptions). In this work, we rethink the human intent-to-CAD pipeline and propose a unified method that directly maps multi-level human intents to executable codes, without assuming the prior existence of target CAD models. To support our study, we construct HiCAD, the first large-scale dataset aligning hand-drawn sketches, textual descriptions, and parametric CAD codes. Based on this, we introduce HiCAD, a two-stage framework comprising Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment to bridge the representational gap between heterogeneous inputs, and Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning to enforce geometric and topological consistency. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms existing baselines across multiple tasks, validating its effectiveness and robustness in transforming heterogeneous human intents into high-fidelity parametric CAD models. Our project page: https://zqwlearning.github.io/HiCAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HiCAD方法，直接将多层级人类意图映射为可执行CAD代码，无需预设目标模型，并构建首个对齐手绘草图、文本描述与参数化CAD代码的大规模数据集，通过两阶段框架显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 从人类意图生成参数化CAD模型仍具挑战性，尤其在设计概念阶段，设计目标常以不完整、非结构化的模态表达（如手绘草图和文本描述）。现有方法往往预设目标CAD模型存在，难以满足实际概念设计需求。
AI.method: 重新审视意图到CAD的流程，提出统一方法将多层级人类意图直接映射为可执行代码。构建HiCAD数据集（首个对齐手绘草图、文本描述和参数化CAD代码的大规模数据集）。提出HiCAD两阶段框架：协作多任务对齐（Cooperative Multi-Task Alignment）弥合异构输入的表示鸿沟；空间感知强化学习（Spatial-Aware Reinforcement Learning）约束几何与拓扑一致性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在多个任务上显著优于现有基线，验证了其将异构人类意图转化为高保真参数化CAD模型的有效性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: HiCAD能够在不依赖预先存在目标CAD模型的条件下，直接从多层级异构人类意图生成高保真参数化CAD模型，为概念设计阶段的人机协同CAD建模提供了有效方案。

title: Towards Autopilot Labeling for Short Video Content Governance
summary: The explosive growth of short videos has presented significant challenges to content governance. Traditional manual labeling is inefficient, slow to iterate, and costly. Therefore, we explore and develop a multi-stage autopilot labeling framework aimed at progressively increasing the level of automation in short video content annotation. To move beyond the heavy reliance on human expert labeling at the initial L0 stage, we first introduce a discriminative MLLM labeler at the L1 stage, which is fine-tuned with supervised data to directly predict labels for short videos. Advancing to the L2 stage, we shift to a domain-adaptive MLLM pretrained on short video data and use it for zero-shot labeling, enabling flexible generalization without task-specific supervision. In the L3 stage, we propose an agentic annotation workflow, and equip the agent with several key tools, which empower the agent to handle complex, unfamiliar, or vaguely defined cases, significantly reducing the need for human intervention. We conduct extensive experiments across various content issues, and results demonstrate that each stage of the autopilot labeling framework progressively improves labeling accuracy, and has significantly reduced manual labor costs in real-world applications by up to 85%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多阶段自动驾驶式标注框架，通过L1判别式MLLM标注器、L2领域自适应零样本标注、L3智能体标注工作流，逐级提升短视频内容标注自动化程度，准确率逐步提升，实际应用中人工成本降低多达85%。
AI.motivation: 短视频内容爆发式增长给内容治理带来巨大挑战，传统人工标注效率低、迭代慢、成本高，需要逐步提升标注自动化水平以减少对人工专家的依赖。
AI.method: 提出多阶段自动驾驶式标注框架：L1阶段引入判别式MLLM标注器，用监督数据微调直接预测短视频标签；L2阶段采用在短视频数据上预训练的领域自适应MLLM进行零样本标注，实现无需任务特定监督的灵活泛化；L3阶段提出智能体标注工作流，为智能体配备若干关键工具，处理复杂、陌生或定义模糊的案例。
AI.result: 在多种内容问题上的大量实验表明，框架每一阶段均逐步提升标注准确率，并在真实应用中大幅减少人工成本，最多降低85%。
AI.conclusion: 该多阶段自动驾驶式标注框架能够逐级提升短视频内容标注的自动化程度与准确率，显著降低人工标注成本，具有实际应用价值。

title: Do LLM Tutors Actually Teach? A Process-Centered Synthesis of the Tutoring Loop
summary: Large language models can produce fluent tu- toring dialogue, but whether they actually help students learn remains unclear. We present a process-centered synthesis of LLM tutoring that follows the path from learner-state infer- ence to pedagogical action, tutor training, eval- uation, and student simulation. This view ex- poses a central gap: implementing a tutoring component does not establish that it works or that its outputs meaningfully affect later stages. A structured study-level audit shows that peda- gogical evaluation is common, while evidence becomes much thinner for learner-conditioned intervention, human learning gains, and espe- cially transfer or delayed retention. Human studies nevertheless provide a conditional posi- tive result: LLM tutors can improve learning, but benefits depend on pedagogical structure, learner engagement, and how learning is mea- sured. We argue that progress requires validat- ing the interfaces between tutoring stages, not only improving individual components.

AI.tldr: 本文对LLM辅导进行以过程为中心的综述，梳理“学习者状态推断→教学行动→导师训练→评估→学生模拟”链条，指出实现某环节并不代表其有效或能影响后续环节；研究级审计显示教学评估较常见，但学习者条件化干预、真实学习增益及迁移/延迟保持证据薄弱。人类研究给出有条件正向结论：LLM导师可提升学习，但取决于教学结构、学习者投入与测量方式。作者主张应验证各阶段间的接口，而非仅优化单个组件。
AI.motivation: LLM能生成流畅的辅导对话，但其是否真正促进学习尚不明确，且现有研究多聚焦单一组件，缺乏对辅导全流程及环节间衔接效度的系统审视，因此需要以过程为中心的整合视角来定位证据缺口。
AI.method: 采用以过程为中心的综述框架，将LLM辅导分解为学习者状态推断、教学行动、导师训练、评估与学生模拟五个阶段；并对研究进行结构化的研究级审计，按证据类型（教学评估、学习者条件化干预、人类学习增益、迁移与延迟保持）统计证据分布。
AI.result: 审计结果显示：教学评估类证据较为普遍；而学习者条件化干预、人类学习增益、迁移与延迟保持方面的证据显著稀薄。人类研究提供有条件正向结果：LLM导师能够改善学习，但效果受教学结构、学习者投入程度及学习测量方式影响。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅导研究的进展不应仅追求单个组件的性能提升，而需重点验证辅导各阶段之间的接口效度，即前一阶段输出是否真实、有效地影响后续阶段，从而建立从推断到学习增益的完整证据链。

title: bharatSetu: a 1M x 22 bridge for indic translation
summary: India's Eighth Schedule recognises 22 languages, yet parallel data is uneven across them, and many language pairs, especially among lower-resource languages such as Bodo, Dogri, Santali and Kashmiri, lack direct bitext. We present BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M, a row-aligned table of 984,764 English sentences, each paired with machine translations into all 22 scheduled languages (21,664,808 Indic cells), generated with the sarvamai/sarvam-translate model family. Because every Indic cell in a row translates the same English sentence, any two columns form a translation pair: 462 directed Indic-to-Indic pairs, or 506 including English, without direct bitext. We call these pivot-derived pairs and propose a confidence layer that lets users choose how strictly each pair is connected. The corpus is machine-generated and not human-verified; quality is expected to vary by language, domain and sentence style, and pivot-derived pairs can inherit errors from both sides. We therefore release BharatSetu as a machine layer and propose a human-correction layer keyed to the same row identifiers, so that each corrected column upgrades every pair that uses it, together with an evaluation protocol. We report no translation-quality results.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布 BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M——一个行对齐的英文句子表格（984,764 行），每行英文句通过 sarvam-translate 机器翻译为印度第八附表全部 22 种语言（21,664,808 个 Indic 单元格），从而在不依赖直接双语文本的情况下衍生出 506 个含英语的有向翻译对，并提出置信度层与人工校正层及评估协议。
AI.motivation: 印度第八附表虽承认 22 种语言，但平行数据分布不均，Bodo、Dogri、Santali、Kashmiri 等低资源语言之间尤其缺乏直接双语文本。为填补这些缺失的语言对，作者提出利用英语作为枢轴，通过行对齐机制间接构造任意两列之间的翻译对。
AI.method: 构建行对齐表格：以 984,764 个英语句子为锚点，用 sarvamai/sarvam-translate 模型族生成全部 22 种印度语言的译句，共 21,664,808 个 Indic 单元格。由于同一行的每个 Indic 单元格都对应同一英文句，任意两列即构成翻译对，得到 462 个有向 Indic-Indic 对（含英语为 506 个），称为"枢轴衍生对"。同时提出置信度层以控制配对连接严格程度，并设计以相同行标识符为键的人工校正层，使任一列的校正可升级所有使用该列的翻译对。
AI.result: 未报告翻译质量结果（no translation-quality results）。作者明确指出语料为机器生成、未经人工校验，质量随语言、领域和句式风格而异，枢轴衍生对可能继承两侧误差，因此仅将其定位为"机器层"并配套人工校正层与评估协议。
AI.conclusion: BharatSetu 以行对齐与枢轴衍生机制，为 22 种印度语言提供了大规模、可扩展的机器翻译资源框架，缓解了低资源语言对缺乏直接双语文本的问题。其贡献主要在于数据结构与协作校正机制的设计，而非翻译质量本身；实际可用性取决于后续人工校正层与评估协议的执行。

title: Generalizable Model Editing Could Be More Than Direct Generalization
summary: A central desideratum in model editing is generalization to complex tasks, which prior work formalizes under a direct generalization paradigm: treating and evaluating LLM behavior as an input-output mapping and expecting a factual update to alter outputs on reasoning tasks. Yet despite substantial empirical effort, the field consensus remains that such generalization is highly challenging and elusive. However, when we deploy the latest models in an in-the-wild chatbot-user setting, we surprisingly find that even classical editing methods exhibit remarkably fluent generalization behavior. This motivates us to revisit the obstacles to generalization and the limitations of the prevailing paradigm. We find that direct generalization is fundamentally constrained both theoretically and practically: theoretically, it suffers from an identifiability issue; and practically, existing approaches attempting to circumvent this are further hindered by the ambiguity of their constructed biases and by vulnerability to being overridden by other factors such as optimization dynamics. We instead identify compositional generalization, empowered by the increasingly strong reasoning and composition abilities of modern LLMs, as a theoretically grounded and empirically validated alternative. We validate this phenomenon across multiple models and editing methods, showing that such generalization behavior is widespread. Overall, we argue that generalizable model editing could be more than direct generalization, and call for a paradigm shift toward more generalizable and practically deployable knowledge update techniques.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑模型编辑中"直接泛化"范式的可行性，发现该范式存在理论上的不可识别性问题，实践上也受构造偏置的模糊性和优化动态干扰的制约；作者提出并验证了以现代LLM推理与组合能力为基础的"组合泛化"作为更合理、可部署的替代范式。
AI.motivation: 模型编辑的核心目标是泛化到复杂任务。既有工作采用"直接泛化"范式，将LLM视为输入-输出映射，期望事实更新能改变推理任务的输出。然而大量实证努力后，领域仍普遍认为该泛化极难实现。作者注意到在真实聊天机器人场景中，经典编辑方法反而表现出流畅的泛化行为，这一反差促使他们重新审视泛化的障碍与主流范式的局限。
AI.method: 作者从理论与实践两方面剖析直接泛化范式：指出其存在不可识别性问题（理论约束），并分析绕行方案受构造偏置模糊性及优化动态等外部因素覆盖的困扰（实践约束）。据此提出"组合泛化"作为替代，依托现代LLM日益增强的推理与组合能力，并在多种模型与多种编辑方法上进行验证，确认该泛化行为的普遍性。
AI.result: 直接泛化在理论上受不可识别性限制，在实践上易受偏置模糊性和优化动态等因素干扰；而组合泛化在多个模型和多种编辑方法上被验证广泛存在，表现出稳定的泛化行为。
AI.conclusion: 可泛化的模型编辑不应局限于直接泛化。作者呼吁范式转变，转向更具泛化性、更贴近实际部署的知识更新技术，并以组合泛化为理论基础与实践方向。

title: Preserving Updates in Low-Bit Recurrent State Quantization
summary: Linear attention and recurrent models compress past tokens into a fixed-size state that is updated at every step. However, storing these states in high precision incurs substantial memory and bandwidth costs at large batch sizes, motivating low-bit state quantization. Unlike weights and key--value caches, a recurrent state is requantized after every update, so its quantization errors accumulate across steps. Our analysis shows that these errors are highly coherent across steps, so reducing per-step errors alone is insufficient. This coherence arises mainly from small updates that are lost in rounding. To preserve these updates, we intervene both before and at rounding. Before rounding, we propose Low-Rank Bypass (LRB), which accumulates small updates in a compact low-rank buffer and periodically merges its sufficiently large elements into the state. At rounding, we observe that a state element can even move opposite to its update, and such reversals prove particularly harmful. Therefore, we propose Bounded Directional Rounding (BDR), which rounds reversed elements toward their updates without additional storage. Although BDR enlarges the rounding error, it improves the model, suggesting that the direction of an update matters more than its rounding error at a single step. Across Gated DeltaNet, GLA, Mamba2, and RetNet, our training-free method substantially outperforms INT4, while reducing state memory by up to 5.3$\times$ and speeding up decoding by up to 1.9$\times$ relative to FP32 states.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练状态量化方法，结合低秩旁路缓冲与有界方向舍入，抑制递归状态量化误差的跨步累积，在多种线性注意力与递归模型上显著优于INT4，状态内存减少最多5.3倍、解码加速最多1.9倍。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力与递归模型将历史token压缩为定长状态并逐步更新，大batch下高精度存储状态带来显著内存与带宽开销，因此需低比特状态量化。但递归状态每次更新后都需重新量化，导致量化误差跨步累积。分析表明这些误差跨步高度相干，仅降低单步误差不足以解决。
AI.method: 误差相干性主要源于舍入中被丢弃的小更新。作者在舍入前后分别干预：舍入前提出低秩旁路LRB，用小规模低秩缓冲累积小更新，并周期性将足够大的元素合并进状态；舍入时提出有界方向舍入BDR，针对状态元素可能朝更新反方向移动（反转）这一有害现象，无额外存储地将反转元素朝其更新方向舍入。
AI.result: 尽管BDR增大了单步舍入误差，模型性能反而提升，说明单步更新的方向比其舍入误差更重要。在Gated DeltaNet、GLA、Mamba2和RetNet上，该免训练方法大幅优于INT4，相对FP32状态内存减少最多5.3倍，解码加速最多1.9倍。
AI.conclusion: 递归状态量化的关键不在单步误差大小，而在误差跨步相干性与更新方向保持；LRB与BDR无需训练即可有效缓解相干误差累积，实现低比特状态下的内存节省与解码加速。

title: TL;QR: Querying Temporal Discursive Patterns in Textual Corpora
summary: Many questions about large textual corpora concern patterns that unfold over time, such as a political group whose stance on a topic drifts from support to criticism over several years of debates. We present TL;QR (Too Long; Query with logical temporal Reasoning), a declarative query language and open-source engine for finding such temporal discursive patterns. In TL;QR, a single query combines natural-language predicates, whose truth is judged by a Large Language Model (LLM), with regular expressions and the operators of a temporal logic. The LLM answers only local questions about individual text passages; a symbolic engine then aggregates these judgments over time and links every match to the recorded passages and predicate decisions behind it. With this division of labor, the temporal and relational reasoning stays exact and auditable even over long time horizons. In addition, when a query includes a regular-expression pre-filter, only a small fraction of the corpus ever reaches the LLM. On a suite of controlled synthetic benchmarks with temporally and semantically complex patterns, TL;QR is substantially more accurate than LLM-only baselines. In a case study on ten years of European Parliament debates (442,593 multilingual speeches), TL;QR identifies candidate shifts in the political groups' stances on the GDPR privacy regulation.

AI.tldr: TL;QR 是一种面向大规模文本语料的声明式查询语言与开源引擎，通过将 LLM 的自然语言谓词判定与正则表达式、时序逻辑算子结合，实现可精确、可审计的长时段话语模式检索。
AI.motivation: 大型文本语料中的许多研究问题涉及随时间演变的模式，例如某政治团体在多年辩论中立场由支持转向批评。这类时序性话语模式难以用现有方法高效、准确且可追溯地检索，而纯 LLM 方案在长时程与复杂时序推理上不够精确。
AI.method: 提出 TL;QR 查询语言与开源引擎：单条查询可组合由 LLM 判定的自然语言谓词、正则表达式以及时序逻辑算子。LLM 仅回答针对单个文本片段的局部问题，符号引擎负责在时间维度上聚合这些判定，并将每个匹配链接到对应的文本片段与谓词决策记录。查询中的正则预过滤可显著减少进入 LLM 的语料比例。
AI.result: 在具有时序与语义复杂模式的受控合成基准上，TL;QR 的准确率显著高于纯 LLM 基线。在十年欧洲议会辩论（442,593 篇多语言演讲）的案例研究中，TL;QR 识别出各政治团体在 GDPR 隐私监管立场上的候选转变。
AI.conclusion: 将 LLM 的局部语义判定与符号化时序/关系推理分工结合，可在长时程上保持推理的精确性与可审计性，同时借助正则预过滤控制 LLM 调用成本，为大规模语料中的时序话语模式发现提供了可行方案。

title: PhySimCode: A Benchmark and Evaluation Method for Physics Video to Code Generation
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are good at video understanding and code generation, but it remains unclear whether they can recover the physical laws underlying videos, a capability essential for converting videos into executable simulations and for providing structured physical supervision in robotics. Captioning motion video does not imply that a model has inferred its governing dynamics, estimated quantitative parameters, or can regenerate the observed scene from code. Existing video-physics benchmarks evaluate plausibility, property estimation, or future-state prediction, but offer limited insight into whether models can translate visual dynamics into runnable simulation code. We introduce PhySimCode, a benchmark for physics video-to-code generation: given only a raw video, a model must infer the relevant physics, recover parameter values, and generate runnable Python that reproduces the input video. The dataset contains 160.6K procedurally generated samples spanning 162 physics phenomena across analytic SciPy simulations and PyBullet-rendered rigid-body, articulated, fluid, and contact-rich scenes; each sample bundles the simulation code, physical parameters, rendered video, and a structured chain-of-thought covering observations, laws, ODEs, numerical methods, and validation checks. We evaluate ten state-of-the-art closed- and open-source MLLMs along physical-law correctness, simulation equivalence, code executability, and parameter recovery. Models reliably state physics laws (4.27-4.93/5) yet score only 1.51-2.47/5 on inferring them from video, and the best system (Claude Sonnet 4.6) recovers just 7.7% of ground-truth parameters within $\pm 20\%$, exposing a substantial video-to-simulation gap. The 2,430-video evaluation set is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/SourajaKundu123/PhySimCode and the evaluation code at https://github.com/SourajaKundu/PhySimCode

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PhySimCode 基准，用于评估多模态大模型从原始视频中推断物理规律、恢复参数并生成可运行仿真代码的能力。数据集含 16.06 万程序生成样本、162 类物理现象。十个先进模型评测显示：模型能陈述物理定律（4.27–4.93/5），但从视频推断仅得 1.51–2.47/5，最佳系统参数恢复率仅 7.7%（±20% 内），暴露显著"视频到仿真"鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视频理解与代码生成上表现优异，但其能否从视频中反演潜在物理定律尚不明确。这一能力对将视频转化为可执行仿真、为机器人提供结构化物理监督至关重要。仅会描述运动视频，并不代表模型能推断支配动力学、估计定量参数或用代码重建场景。现有视频-物理基准多评估合理性、属性估计或未来状态预测，难以判断模型能否把视觉动力学转译为可运行仿真代码。
AI.method: 构建 PhySimCode 基准，任务是"物理视频到代码生成"：仅输入原始视频，模型需推断相关物理、恢复参数值并生成可复现输入视频的可运行 Python 代码。数据集包含 16.06 万个程序化生成样本，覆盖 162 种物理现象，包括基于 SciPy 的解析仿真与 PyBullet 渲染的刚体、铰接体、流体及富接触场景；每个样本打包仿真代码、物理参数、渲染视频，以及覆盖观测、定律、常微分方程、数值方法与验证检查的结构化思维链。评测维度包括物理定律正确性、仿真等价性、代码可执行性与参数恢复。
AI.result: 在十个先进闭源与开源 MLLM 上评测：模型能可靠陈述物理定律（4.27–4.93/5），但从视频中推断定律仅得 1.51–2.47/5；最佳系统（Claude Sonnet 4.6）在 ±20% 容差下仅恢复 7.7% 的真实参数，凸显显著的"视频到仿真"差距。2,430 段视频评测集已发布于 Hugging Face，评测代码开源于 GitHub。
AI.conclusion: 现有 MLLM 虽掌握显式物理知识陈述，却难以从视觉动力学中反演支配规律与定量参数，更难以生成等价可运行的仿真代码，视频到仿真之间仍存在实质鸿沟。PhySimCode 为该方向提供了标准化评测资源，推动模型从"描述视频"走向"重建动力学"。

title: Visually Legible but Adversarial: Watermark-Constrained Attacks on End-to-End VLMs for Document Understanding
summary: Visible watermarks convey document ownership, confidentiality, and status, but can also carry adversarial signals. We introduce Auto-Regional Adversarial Watermarking (AR-AWM), a model-aware white-box attack on end-to-end visual language models (VLMs) for document understanding. AR-AWM constructs a small, spatially distributed watermark-text support and optimizes only its pixels to disrupt visual representations. The attack is untargeted and question-agnostic: generation uses no questions, answers, parsing prompts, language-model gradients, or language-model outputs. Each attacked page is reused across downstream queries. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B, a watermark support covering 7.98% of page pixels under the reporting threshold reduces DocVQA exact match from 0.899 to 0.150 and average normalized Levenshtein similarity (ANLS) from 0.939 to 0.212. Selected qualitative cases retain visually legible source fields. The same support without optimization and with matched random perturbations retains ANLS of 0.932 and 0.933, respectively, identifying adversarial optimization as the primary cause of degradation. Layout-matched optimized rectangles yield ANLS of 0.276, showing an incremental benefit from text-shaped geometry. AR-AWM also degrades all reported text, formula, reading-order, and table metrics on OmniDocBench. Separate white-box optimization on InternVL2.5-8B reduces ANLS from 0.922 to 0.046, while weak cross-model transfer reveals strong encoder specificity. These results identify conventional watermark-shaped supports as an adversarial surface for document VLMs in the evaluated white-box setting.luated white-box setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AR-AWM，一种针对端到端视觉语言模型（VLM）文档理解的白盒对抗水印攻击。它构建空间分布的水印文本支撑区域，仅优化其像素以扰乱视觉表征，攻击与问题无关且可复用。
AI.motivation: 可见水印通常用于传达文档归属、机密性和状态，但也可能被滥用来携带对抗信号。作者希望揭示常规水印形状的支撑区域可作为文档VLM的对抗攻击面，探索这种攻击的有效性与机制。
AI.method: 提出Auto-Regional Adversarial Watermarking（AR-AWM），一种模型感知的白盒攻击。它构建小型、空间分布的水印-文本支撑区域，仅优化其像素以干扰视觉表征。攻击为非定向且问题无关：生成过程不使用问题、答案、解析提示、语言模型梯度或输出，每个被攻击页面可跨下游查询复用。
AI.result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上，覆盖7.98%页面像素的水印支撑在报告阈值下将DocVQA精确匹配从0.899降至0.150，ANLS从0.939降至0.212。未优化和匹配随机扰动的相同支撑分别保持ANLS为0.932和0.933，表明对抗优化是性能下降的主因。布局匹配的优化矩形ANLS为0.276，显示文本形状几何带来增量收益。AR-AWM在OmniDocBench上降低了所有报告的文本、公式、阅读顺序和表格指标。在InternVL2.5-8B上独立白盒优化将ANLS从0.922降至0.046，弱跨模型迁移揭示强编码器特异性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在所评估的白盒设定下，常规水印形状的支撑区域构成文档VLM的对抗攻击面。对抗优化是性能退化主因，且攻击具有强编码器特异性。

title: NepPlural: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Persona Annotation in Nepali Migration Discourse
summary: Pluralistic alignment asks that language models faithfully represent a society's diverse, competing values rather than collapse them into one dominant viewpoint, yet flagship pluralistic-alignment datasets remain heavily skewed toward Western respondents. We introduce NepPlural, a human-anchored benchmark for modelling competing socio-cultural personas in Nepali public discourse on youth migration and brain drain. We curate 2,148 code-mixed (Devanagari, Romanized Nepali, English) YouTube comments, annotate them along a four-axis persona taxonomy (Intent, Primary Driver, Value Orientation, Affect) plus an explicit No-Persona class, and build a 300-comment gold set labelled independently by three native Nepali speakers (mean Fleiss' $κ\approx 0.55$). Using this gold set to audit automatic annotation, we find that LLM annotation reliability is driven by protocol. Labels collected in batches through chat interfaces reach only near-chance inter-model agreement ($κ\approx 0.17$). Annotating one comment at a time raises agreement above the native-speaker level ($κ\approx 0.72$), but consistency is not validity: under a forced-choice schema, models agree on personas for the 39% of comments native speakers judge to express none, keeping macro-F1 against human gold near 0.50. Allowing abstention resolves this: models recover No-Persona comments with F1 of 0.79 to 0.87 and, against leave-one-annotator-out references, match or exceed individual native speakers (macro-F1 0.75 to 0.86 vs. 0.75). Encoders fine-tuned on the batched labels reach only 0.34. Finally, a human-judged steerability probe finds that three frontier models adopt single persona axes with 59 to 77% fidelity but compose full personas only 33% of the time, with no congruence gap detected at this scale between Western-congruent and Nepali-collectivist personas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NepPlural，一个以尼泊尔青年移民与人才流失公共话语为背景、由母语者标注的多元对齐基准，并系统审计了 LLM 自动标注的协议效应与效度边界。
AI.motivation: 主流多元对齐数据集严重偏向西方受访者，难以忠实刻画社会中多元且相互竞争的价值立场；需要非西方语境下、有人类锚定的基准来检验模型对竞争性社会文化人格的建模能力。
